Name: Trippy Light Random Colors Effect automation (Script call)
Description: While the trippy lights toggle is on and the warm variant is off, keeps giving every lit color light (all-lights group, not in color-temperature mode) a new random color via 'Change received lights to random colors' using the trippy saturation and speed settings, waiting twice the fade time per round. Once the toggle is off, it finishes the round and re-applies Adaptive Lighting unless the warm effect took over; speed changes restart it.

Name: Add playing Spotify or tidal artist to Lidarr
Description: Each time the artist changes on the Music Assistant home speaker group and the track's content ID points to Spotify or Tidal, searches MusicBrainz for the artist, takes the top result and, if one is found, adds that artist by name and MusicBrainz ID to Lidarr through a REST command. Runs queue up (max 4) so quick track changes are handled in turn.

Name: Adjust all player speakers volume when myriam arrives
Description: When Myriam's person entity arrives home after more than 10 minutes away, finds every playing Music Assistant speaker except the home group and runs the Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script on each. That script sets the time-of-day volume and unmutes the speaker, re-muting it if music following is on and its room has no motion.

Name: Adjust Bedroom Tablet brightness to match the lights
Description: When the bedroom light group changes (on/off or brightness) and holds for 3 seconds, copies its raw brightness value (0-255) to the bedroom tablet's screen brightness, or sets the screen to 0 when the lights are off, so the tablet dims along with the room.

Name: Adjust closet tablet screen brightness to match the lights
Description: Whenever the closet lights change and hold for 2 seconds, copies their raw brightness value to the closet tablet's screen brightness (0 when the lights are off), but only while the tablet battery is above 50%.

Name: Adjust hallway tablet screen brightness to match the lights
Description: Whenever the hallway lights' brightness changes and holds for 1 second, copies that value to the hallway tablet's screen brightness (0 when the lights go off), as long as the tablet battery is above 30%.

Name: Adjust Kitchen Tablet brightness to match the lights
Description: Whenever the hotbox bed lights change (on/off or brightness) and hold for 1 second, sets the hotbox bed tablet's screen brightness to the lights' raw brightness value (0-255), or to 0 when they are off. Despite the name, it has nothing to do with the kitchen tablet.

Name: Adjust volume of voice assistants on answering
Description: When any of the 11 voice assistants starts responding, sets the media players on that assistant's device to 75% volume if Adaptive Lighting sleep mode is on, otherwise to 100% (parallel mode, so several assistants can answer at once).

Name: Adjust workshop tablet screen brightness to match the lights
Description: When the workshop light group's brightness changes and holds for 1 second, copies that brightness value to the workshop tablet's screen brightness (0 when the lights turn off), but only if the tablet battery is above 30% and nobody is marked as sleeping in the workshop.

Name: Alarm: disarm rules
Description: Disarms the home alarm when someone comes home while it's armed away; when it's armed night and someone wakes while the sun is up, or at sunrise if Maxi is already awake; or whenever Maxi, Myriam, Lylou or Felix unlocks the front door with their keypad code, in any mode. Keypad unlocks also snapshot the front door camera and run the important broadcast alert announcing who 'is in the place', with a high-priority arrival notification and snapshot to Maxi.

Name: Alert house-wide when there is smoke in the kitchen
Description: When either kitchen smoke detector reports smoke, and every 3 minutes while either still does, notifies Maxi (high priority, with the kitchen tablet camera image) and sends an important house alert ('Attention, Smoke detected in the kitchen, Please investigate.') with white lights. Mode restart: a second detector tripping restarts the cycle immediately.

Name: Alert house-wide when there is water leakage under the dishwasher
Description: When the water leak detector under the dishwasher turns wet, repeats every 4 minutes while it stays wet: runs the important broadcast alert (white notification lights and a spoken warning about water under the dishwasher) and sends Maxi a phone notification about a kitchen leak.

Name: Alert house-wide when water leakage is detected in the bathroom
Description: When the water detector behind the bathroom toilet turns wet, repeats every 4 minutes while it stays wet: runs the important broadcast alert (white notification lights and a spoken warning about water behind the toilet) and sends Maxi a phone notification about a bathroom leak.

Name: Alert house-wide when water leakage is detected in the kitchen
Description: When the kitchen water sensor detects a leak, loops every 4 minutes for as long as it stays wet: runs the house-wide broadcast alert script with a white light flash and a spoken leak warning for the kitchen, and sends Maxi a high-priority notification showing the kitchen tablet camera.

Name: Alert Housewide when Kitchen timer is finished
Description: When the cooking timer goes from active to idle (finished or cancelled) and the kitchen shows no occupancy, makes a low-priority 'Kitchen Timer Finished!' house announcement, then repeats it every 5 minutes for as long as the kitchen stays empty. Mode single ignores new timer ends while it is repeating.

Name: Alert if someone is loitering by the car for too long
Description: When the parking exit camera has seen a person for 30 seconds while it also sees a car, Myriam is at Maxi's and there's no back-yard party, snapshots that camera and sends Maxi a high-priority 'Person near the car' alert with the image and a 'Blow the horn for 2 minutes?' button, which the 'Turn parking horn on' automation handles.

Name: Alert if the front door remains unlocked for too long
Description: Once the front door lock has been unlocked for 6 minutes, sends an important house alert ('Front Lock has remained unlocked', yellow lights) and a high-priority notification to Maxi, repeating every 3 minutes; each round, including the first, runs only while the door is still unlocked and the apartment isn't being aired out.

Name: Alert maxi if someone comes in while he is sleeping
Description: When the patio, server, back outside, entrance or front outside door opens while the alarm is armed for the night and Maxi is home, sends Maxi a high-priority 'Someone is inside!' alert naming the door, with a Frigate snapshot and a 'Blare inside alert?' button. It also turns every light on at 100% and 4805 K and has Piper announce which door opened on the bedroom speaker at 56% volume.

Name: Alert maxi if someone enters his room while alarm is set to armed home
Description: When the bedroom door opens or bedroom motion starts while the alarm is armed home, sends Maxi a high-priority security notification, then keeps saying 'Please leave this room immediately.' on the bedroom speaker at full volume, with 5-second pauses, while the door is open or motion continues and the alarm stays armed home. It then waits for motion to clear for 5 minutes; new triggers restart it.

Name: alert maxi if someone goes into the hotbox during a party
Description: When the hotbox door opens or hotbox motion starts while the home alarm is armed home (as during a party), sends Maxi a high-priority "Security Alert" notification saying someone has entered the hotbox, on the security alerts channel.

Name: Alert maxi when people are too noisy on the patio during a party
Description: During party mode with someone on the patio, when the patio camera hears yelling, cheering or crowd noise for 10 seconds or the patio sound level rises above -25 dB: if Maxi is home, sends Maxi a noise alert with a patio camera image; if Maxi is away, sends 'Please reduce the noise on the Patio!' to the house broadcast, which does nothing in party mode, and tells Maxi with the image.

Name: Alert Maxi when the automatic back horn is disabled
Description: When 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn mode) turns off while maximum back exit security is off, sends Maxi a high-priority 'Automatic Back Horn Disabled' security alert with a 'Turn it back on' button; a separate automation re-enables the mode when that button is tapped.

Name: Alert myriam when lylou nears home
Description: When Lylou's person entity goes from away to home after more than 240 seconds (4 minutes) away, sends Myriam a 'Lylou is nearing home!' notification, unless Myriam is currently at Maxi's (binary_sensor.myriam_at_maxis on).

Name: Alert people in the back to go away
Description: When the back door loitering sensor has seen a person for 30 seconds and the back outside door isn't open, sends Maxi a high-priority 'Security Alert' with the back door camera image and an 'Open Cameras' button, then flashes the back door light red until the camera has seen nobody for 10 seconds, leaving it off. The following 30-second clear wait is skipped (timeout 0).

Name: Alert that the front door remained open
Description: When the front door (binary_sensor.sensor_front_door_contact, not the outside door) has been open for 3 minutes, and the apartment isn't being aired out and party mode is off, announces 'Front door remained opened' as a low-priority alert via the non-important broadcast alert script. Repeats every 5 minutes while the door stays open and airing mode stays off; party mode is only checked at the start.

Name: Alert that the vacuum is stuck
Description: When the Roborock Qrevo Curv vacuum has been in an error state for 5 minutes, announces 'Vacuum Stuck in <current room>' (room taken from the vacuum's current-room sensor) via the non-important broadcast alert script. It repeats the announcement every 10 minutes, checking after each wait, until the vacuum is no longer in error.

Name: Alert when Airfryer has finished
Description: When the air fryer plug climbs past 100 W while Maxi is awake, not everyone present is asleep and cooking mode is off, gives the fryer up to 20 minutes to drop under 4 W for a minute; each new climb restarts the run. If the kitchen is then empty, announces 'AirFryer finished' via the non-important house broadcast, again every 5 minutes while it stays empty.

Name: Alert when back horns rings and offer to turn it off
Description: When the back door horn switches on, snapshots the back door camera and sends a 'Back horn started' alert with a 'Stop the horn?' button to Maxi (twice, 3 s apart), to Myriam if Myriam is at Maxi's, and, if Lylou is home without Maxi or Myriam, to Lylou after raising Lylou's phone volumes to 20. A Stop tap within 3 minutes turns the horn off; otherwise it stays on.

Name: Alert when Dishwasher finishes and no one is in the kitchen
Description: When the dishwasher plug rises above 100 W while Maxi is awake and not everyone home is asleep, waits up to 1 hour for it to stay under 5 W for a minute, then announces 'The Dishwasher has finished' through the non-important house broadcast script (nothing on timeout; mode restart, so each new rise above 100 W restarts the wait). Despite the name, kitchen occupancy is never checked.

Name: Alert when dryer finishes!
Description: Announces 'Dryer has finished' through the low-priority house alert script as soon as the dryer's status sensor switches to 'end', provided Maxi is awake and not everyone at home is asleep. It announces only once; a disabled loop that would have kept checking the kitchen every 30 minutes never runs.

Name: Alert when Kitchen asssistant timer finishes
Description: Five seconds after the Kitchen Assistant's timer starts or stops ringing, if the Cooking timer's last transition was 'finished' and the kitchen motion group shows nobody, announces 'Kitchen Assistant Timer Finished!' via the non-important broadcast alert, then repeats it every 5 minutes for as long as the kitchen stays motion-free, without checking whether the timer was dismissed.

Name: Alert when Microwave finishes
Description: Once the microwave plug passes 100 W, provided Maxi is awake, not everyone home is asleep and cooking mode is off, gives the microwave up to 30 minutes to fall below 5 W (otherwise it gives up). If nobody is then detected in the kitchen, announces 'Microwave finished' via the low-priority house alert and repeats it every 5 minutes until kitchen motion is detected; re-running the microwave restarts everything.

Name: Alert when parking horn starts and offer to turn it off
Description: When the parking horn plug turns on, snapshots the parking exit camera and sends a high-priority 'Security breach' alert with the image and a 'Stop the horn?' button to Maxi's notification group, to Myriam if Myriam is at Maxi's, and again directly to Maxi's phone 3 seconds later. A tap on any of these alerts within 40 minutes turns the horn off; if the horn starts again meanwhile, the run restarts.

Name: Alert when parking siren goes on and offer to turn it off
Description: Fires when the parking exit camera siren switches on. It saves a snapshot from the parking exit camera and pushes a high-priority 'Security breach' alert ('Parking horn started') with that image and a 'Stop the horn?' button to Maxi's phone, plus Myriam's phone if Myriam is at Maxi's; a tap within 3 minutes silences the camera siren but leaves the horn plug alone.

Name: Alert when smoke is detected in the hallway
Description: When the hallway smoke detector detects smoke, loops every 3 minutes while it still reports smoke: sends Maxi a high-priority notification with an image from the hallway tablet camera and runs the important broadcast alert, flashing the notification lights white and announcing a smoke warning. In restart mode, a new detection restarts the loop.

Name: Alert when someone  is going through the entire yard toward the hobo stash
Description: When the parking exit camera spots a person or bicycle and house sitting mode is off, snapshots the parking exit and yard cameras, waits with no timeout for the back-yard camera and then the hobo-stash zone to detect someone, and alerts Maxi that the hobo might be back. Maxi's tap on the alert within 10 minutes sounds the back door and parking horns until the back-yard camera is clear of people for 10 seconds.

Name: Alert when someone is in the back (Reolink)
Description: When the Reolink back door camera detects a person and the back-yard party flag is off, snapshots the camera and sends Maxi a high-priority security alert with the image and a 'Blow the horn for 2 minutes?' button. A tap within 5 minutes turns on the back door horn (another automation stops it after 2 minutes). A new detection restarts the run and the wait.

Name: Alert when someone is in the parking
Description: When one of the four parking person detectors turns on, snapshots the matching camera and sends Maxi a high-priority 'Someone is in the parking!' (or 'parking exit') alert with buttons to blow the horn or open that camera in the Reolink app. Requires no back-yard party, Maxi within the around-Montreal zone, and parking high alert on or Myriam or Myriam's car present; parallel mode lets each detector alert separately.

Name: Alert when someone is on the back door balcony
Description: When a person has been detected at the back entrance for a second and no back-yard party is on, sends Maxi a high-priority 'Someone is near the back door!' alert with a 'Blow the horn for 2 minutes?' button, and only then snapshots the back door camera to the image file the alert shows. If Maxi taps the button within 5 minutes, turns on the back door horn.

Name: Alert when the fridge remains open
Description: Once the fridge door has been open for 4 minutes, announces 'The Fridge door is open, please close it.' as an important house alert and repeats it every 4 minutes for as long as the door stays open.

Name: Alert when the horn goes off and offer to turn it off
Description: Alerts Maxi and Myriam the moment the front door horn plug switches on: snapshots the front door camera and sends each a 'Horn started' notification titled 'Security breach' with the picture and a 'Stop the horn?' button. A tap from either within 3 minutes switches the horn off; without one, this automation leaves the horn alone (another automation stops it after 2 minutes).

Name: Alert when the stove water is boiling.
Description: When the stove sensor's humidity rises above 80% (steam from boiling water) and cooking mode is off, makes a low-priority house announcement, 'The water is boiling in the Kitchen' (not spoken in party mode or when everyone is asleep), then waits 15 minutes, which with mode single blocks repeat alerts.

Name: Alert when there is motion inside during arm away and trigger alarm
Description: When any of six doors stays open for 10 seconds or an interior motion sensor changes state, while the alarm is armed away, armed vacation or triggered: turns off music following and all lights, sends Maxi a high-priority 'Intruder Alert' naming the area with a Frigate snapshot and a 'Blare inside alert?' button, rings Maxi's phone with the Find phone script, and triggers the alarm unless it already is.

Name: Alert when Toaster finishes
Description: When the toaster plug rises above 50 W while Maxi is awake, not everyone is asleep and cooking mode is off, waits up to 20 minutes for it to stay under 2 W for 5 seconds; then, if the kitchen is empty or Maxi is alone and not in the kitchen, announces 'The Toaster has finished' through the non-important house broadcast script. The toaster power sensor no longer exists, so it never triggers now.

Name: Alert when Washer finishes
Description: Once the washer plug's current climbs above 1 A, if Maxi is awake and not everyone home is asleep, it waits indefinitely for the current to stay below 0.01 A for a full minute and then announces 'Washer finished' through the low-priority house alert script. Conditions are checked only at the start; a new rise above 1 A restarts the wait.

Name: Analyze person in the parking when car is present to detect burglary
Description: Each time someone has been in the parking for 15 s, 30 s, 1 min or 1.5 min, if the parking camera sees a car and there's no back-yard party, asks LLM Vision, from 6 s of the parking exit camera, whether the person is interacting with the car. On a yes, runs 'Find phone' (rings Maxi's phone) and sends Maxi a 'Car break-in attempt' alert with a 'Ring the siren!' parking-horn button.

Name: Arm Alarm-Away when "User home" is off for 10 minutes
Description: Arms the home alarm in away mode when the Users Present sensor has been off for 10 minutes, or when the home zone's person count has been 0 for 10 minutes. There are no conditions, so either trigger arms it away regardless of the alarm's current state.

Name: Arm night alarm when everyone is sleeping
Description: Once the All Present Sleeping sensor has stayed on for 5 minutes, meaning Maxi is home and asleep and the number of active sleepers covers everyone at home, arms the home alarm in night mode. No other conditions are checked.

Name: Assist Equalize volume in the house
Description: When someone tells Assist to "equalize the volume" or "normalize the volume", reads the average volume of the unmuted speakers. With music following off, sets the hallway, kitchen, salon, lounge and workshop WiiM speakers to that average; with it on, loops over the unmuted rooms and sets each room's universal speakers player (media_player.universal_…_speakers) to it instead.

Name: Assist mute ESP32 endpoints when room is unoccupied
Description: When any of 13 room occupancy groups (all but the bedroom) goes from occupied to clear and stays clear for 2 minutes, turns on every switch in that room's area whose ID ends in "mute", muting its ESP32 voice assistant microphones. Runs in parallel so several rooms can be handled at once.

Name: Assist Restart Music Assistant
Description: When someone says 'Restart Music Assistant' to Assist, restarts the Music Assistant beta add-on through the Supervisor. There are no conditions and no custom spoken reply, so Assist just gives its default confirmation.

Name: Assist Show cameras on TVs
Description: When someone asks Assist to show or put the cameras on the TVs (e.g. 'show me the cameras on the TVs'), loads the front door camera's live stream with DashCast on every Chromecast except any Hotbox one, forcing it to replace whatever is playing.

Name: assist Stop home group music
Description: When someone says 'stop music' or 'stop the music' to Assist, stops playback on the Music Assistant home speaker group (media_player.group_mass_home_group_speakers). Room speakers playing on their own, outside that group, are not touched.

Name: Assist Trigger find my phone
Description: When anyone tells Assist "where is my phone", "find my phone" or "phone now", runs the Find phone script to make Maxi's phone ring so it can be found: the script raises the ring volume, turns off Do Not Disturb and sends a high-priority alert.

Name: Assist turn off ESP32 endpoint screens when room is unoccupied
Description: When any of the 14 room occupancy groups, bedroom included, has been clear for 1 minute 45 seconds, turns off every light in that room's area whose ID ends in "screen", meaning the ESP32 voice assistant displays. No sleeper or other checks apply, and runs are parallel so several rooms can be handled at once.

Name: Assist turn on ESP32 endpoint screens when room is occupied
Description: When occupancy goes from off to on in any of the 14 room occupancy groups and that room has no active sleeper flag (hotbox top/down count as hotbox), turns on every light in the room's area whose ID ends in "screen", waking its ESP32 voice assistant displays. Runs in parallel so several rooms can be handled at once.

Name: Assist Unmute ESP32 endpoints when room is occupied
Description: When occupancy turns on in any of the 14 room occupancy groups and that room has no active sleeper flag (hotbox top/down count as hotbox), turns off every switch in the room's area whose ID ends in "mute", unmuting its ESP32 voice assistant microphones. Runs in parallel so several rooms can be handled at once.

Name: Auto close closet tablet screen when someone is sleeping
Description: When the closet tablet's screen turns on while input_boolean.sleeper_in_closet is on (someone sleeping in the closet), waits one minute and switches the screen off again so it doesn't stay lit beside the sleeper. The sleeper flag is only checked when the screen comes on.

Name: Auto-lock doors when closed for 5 seconds
Description: When the front or back outside door's contact sensor has reported the door closed for 5 seconds, locks that door's lock (lock.lock_front_door or lock.back_door) unless it is already locked. Runs in parallel (up to 2), so both doors can be handled at the same time.

Name: Auto-timeout safety net for temporary input booleans
Description: Turns each temporary mode boolean back off once it has stayed on past its limit: Waiting for someone after 1 h, Waiting for Uber after 1 h 30 min, airing the apartment, back-yard party and cooking mode after 4 h, the front-door guest-code flag after 6 h, neighbours' party after 8 h, closet and workshop sleeper after 10 h, party mode and Acid Time after 16 h, and parking high alert after 18 h.

Name: Automatically adjust bathroom volume on unmute
Description: Meant to run when the bathroom speaker is unmuted after being muted for over 30 seconds while neither house broadcast script (important or non-important) is running; it then calls the 'Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script' to set the speaker's time-of-day volume. However, the trigger compares the boolean mute attribute with the quoted strings 'true'/'false', so in practice it never fires.

Name: Automatically turn back door light back off
Description: Once the back door light has been on for 10 minutes, fades it off over 60 seconds if the back door camera detects no person at that moment. If someone is detected then, the light stays on, since the automation does not check again later.

Name: Automatically turn off Back door light when there is no motion
Description: When the back door occupancy sensor goes from occupied to clear and stays clear for 2 minutes, fades the back door light off over 60 seconds and turns off the Reolink back door camera's floodlight.

Name: Automatically turn off bathroom light
Description: When the bathroom has shown no motion for 7 minutes, fades the bathroom lights off over 30 seconds, but only if the shower isn't in use and the bathroom door is open. If either check fails, it won't try again until motion comes and goes once more.

Name: Automatically Turn off sleeper in patio
Description: Once the patio sleeper flag has been on for 50 minutes, waits for the patio motion group to turn on and stay on for 25 minutes (read as the sleeper being up), giving up after 3 hours, then turns input_boolean.sleeper_in_patio off either way.

Name: Automatically turn off the back security horn after 2 minutes and ask if it should restart
Description: When the back door horn has been on for 2 minutes, turns it off, snapshots the back door camera and sends Maxi a 'Security breach: Horn stopped' notification with the snapshot and a 'Restart the horn?' button. If Maxi taps it within 5 minutes the horn comes back on, so the cycle repeats 2 minutes later; with no tap the run simply ends.

Name: Automatically turn off the front security horn after 2 minutes and ask if it should restart
Description: Caps the front door horn at 2 minutes: once switch.plug_front_door_horn has been on that long, it is switched off, the front door camera is snapshotted, and Maxi gets a 'Horn stopped' notification titled 'Security breach' with the picture and a 'Restart the horn?' button. Tapping it within 5 minutes switches the horn back on for another 2-minute cycle.

Name: Automatically turn off the parking security horn after 2 minutes and ask if it should restart
Description: Once the parking horn plug has been on for 2 minutes, turns it off, snapshots the parking exit camera and sends Maxi's notification group a 'Horn stopped' alert with the image and a 'Restart the horn?' button. A tap within 5 minutes turns the horn back on, which starts another 2-minute cycle.

Name: Automatically turn off TVs
Description: Twenty minutes after motion stops in the workshop, salon, bedroom or hotbox, sends the Google Assistant SDK the text command 'Power off' followed by the friendly name of that room's first non-universal Chromecast player. There are no other conditions, so the command goes out even if the TV is already off.

Name: Avoid trippy lights dual activation
Description: Keeps the two trippy light effects mutually exclusive: when the trippy lights effect turns on it switches off the trippy warm colors effect, and when the trippy warm colors effect turns on it switches off the trippy lights effect.

Name: Back door floodlight auto-mode on sunset, off on sunrise
Description: At sunset, switches the back door camera's floodlight mode to 'auto' so it can light up on motion overnight; at sunrise, sets the mode to 'off' for the day.

Name: Back lock automation on main codes
Description: When the back door lock (the Z-Wave 'Lock Kitchen Door') reports a keypad unlock with a user code, maps codes 1, 2 and 3 to Maxi, Myriam and Lylou, and any other code to 'Someone'. It then runs the important broadcast alert script to announce that this person has entered: spoken unless party mode is on, a cyan flash of the notification lights, and a high-priority doorbell-channel notification to Maxi's phone.

Name: Bathroom LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the bathroom light group (light.group_bathroom_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Bedroom door Hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the bedroom door Hue dial to light.group_bedroom_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off bedroom UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: bedroom hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the bedroom Hue dial to light.group_bedroom_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off bedroom UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Boost assist answers when answering with music
Description: When one of nine Assist satellites starts listening while music plays on its area's Music Assistant speaker (or the following-media player) and nobody sleeps there, tries to raise the room's speaker gain to 12, waits up to a minute for the satellite to go idle, then sets it back to 4. Nothing actually changes: a misplaced filter leaves the gain lookup empty, and the gain controls are number entities, not input_numbers.

Name: Change light to random colors on press
Description: Triggered by the input_boolean.random_colors toggle switching on or by the Assist phrases 'random colors/color/colored lights', it runs 'Change received lights to random colors' on the all-lights group with only_on, giving each light that's already on its own random hue while off lights stay off. The toggle is not reset here, so it must be switched off before it can fire again.

Name: Change light to random pastel colors on press
Description: Triggered by the input_boolean.random_pastel_colors toggle switching on or by the Assist phrases 'pastel colors/color/colored lights', it runs 'Change received lights to random pastel colors' on the all-lights group with only_on, giving each light that's already on its own random low-saturation hue while off lights stay off. The toggle is not reset here, so it must be switched off before it can fire again.

Name: close bedroom blind in relation to bedroom ac
Description: When the bedroom AC plug turns off, or whenever the bedroom blinds settle at a new position for 2 seconds, fully closes the blinds if the plug is off and they are less than 20% open. This removes the AC gap once the AC stops, and also shuts any small opening under 20% made while the AC is off.

Name: Close bedroom blinds when sun sets
Description: Every evening, once the sun has been below the horizon for 10 minutes, closes the bedroom blinds. It has no conditions, so it runs whether or not anyone is home.

Name: Close blinds when the house is empty
Description: When the home zone has been empty for 5 minutes (its person count drops below 1), closes all blinds, targeting both the all-blinds group and the bedroom blinds. There are no other conditions, so it runs at any time of day.

Name: Close hotbox blind at sunset
Description: Every evening, once the sun has been below the horizon for 10 minutes, closes the hotbox blinds. It has no conditions, so it runs regardless of who is home or whether the hotbox AC is on.

Name: Close hotbox blind in relationship to ac
Description: After the hotbox blinds settle at a new position for 5 seconds, or when the salon AC plug turns off, fully closes the hotbox blinds, but only if the hotbox AC plug is off and the blinds are open less than 19% (e.g. still at the 18% gap kept while the AC runs).

Name: Close Kitchen curtains when sun sets
Description: Once the sun has been below the horizon for 10 minutes after setting, closes the kitchen curtains (cover.cover_kitchen_curtains). There are no conditions, so it happens every evening whether or not anyone is home.

Name: Close salon blind in relationship to ac
Description: Whenever the salon blind settles at a position for 5 seconds or the salon AC plug turns off, fully closes the blind if the AC plug is off and the blind is less than 30% open, so a low partial opening isn't kept once the AC is off.

Name: Close salon blind sometimes after sun closes
Description: 45 minutes after sunset, waits with no time limit until the salon's occupancy next changes to clear and stays clear for 10 minutes (an already-empty salon must first be entered and left), then closes the salon blinds.

Name: Close salon blind upon sunset
Description: Every evening, once the sun has been below the horizon for 10 minutes, closes the salon blinds. Nothing else is checked, so it runs every day regardless of who is home.

Name: Close workshop Blind in relation to AC
Description: Whenever the workshop blind settles at a position for 2 seconds or the workshop AC plug turns off, fully closes the blind if the AC plug is off and the blind is less than 30% open, so a low partial opening isn't kept once the AC is off.

Name: Conditionally Unmute Speakers when a room is occupied
Description: When motion starts in one of ten rooms (or the patio camera sees a person) while music following is on, unmutes that room's playing Music Assistant speakers, unless the room has a sleeper, an unmuted TV or an active microphone. If the room had no motion for over 1000 seconds (about 17 minutes), it also runs the Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script to reset their time-of-day volume.

Name: Confirm unlock front door on doorbell action
Description: Two-step remote unlock: when Maxi taps Unlock on a doorbell notification, snapshots the front door camera and sends Maxi an 'Unlock Front Door?' notification with the image and a confirm button. If Maxi confirms within 7.5 minutes and the door is locked, unlocks it and sends 'Door Unlocked!' once it reports unlocked; if already unlocked, sends 'Door Already Unlocked!'. No confirmation, no action.

Name: Control bedroom tablet screen to avoid full discharge
Description: When the bedroom tablet's battery drops below 50% while its screen is on, dims the screen to brightness 25; if the reading is already under 15% when it triggers, it sets brightness to 1 and turns the screen off instead. The 'rises above 95%' trigger matches no branch, so it does nothing.

Name: Control Bedroom Thermostat in relation to Bedroom sleeper
Description: Two minutes after the bedroom sleeper flag turns on, switches the Bedroom AC thermostat off and, 2 seconds later, turns the AC plug on directly, so the AC runs non-stop without thermostat control until the wake-up automation turns the thermostat back on. A disabled older block (plug off after sunrise, thermostat on after waking) never runs.

Name: Control brightness of Front door Phone to avoid discharge
Description: When the front door phone's battery drops below 50% with its screen on, sets screen brightness to 50, or to 5 and turns the screen off if the reading is under 15%. When the battery rises above 90% with the screen off, turns it on at brightness 100. With the every-change trigger disabled, the under-15% case only runs if the first reading below 50% is already under 15%.

Name: Control closet tablet screen to avoid full discharge
Description: When the closet tablet's battery drops below 30% while its screen is on, sets the screen brightness to 1 and turns the screen off. Its other trigger (battery entering the 50–55% band) can never satisfy the 'below 50%, dim to 25' branch, so that trigger does nothing.

Name: Control Hallway Tablet charging
Description: On every hallway tablet battery change, manages its charging plug: above 90% it turns the plug off, and below 15% it turns the plug on and dims the screen brightness to 25. Otherwise, if the battery is above 20% and the tablet reports being plugged in, it sets screen brightness back to 100; between 15% and 20% nothing happens.

Name: Control Hotbox Circulator in relation to AC plug
Description: When the hotbox AC plug turns on, turns on the hotbox circulator fan plug and repeats the turn-on 90 seconds later; when the AC plug turns off, turns the circulator off. Because it runs in single mode, an AC-off during that 90-second wait is ignored and the fan stays on.

Name: Control workshop secondary tablet screen to avoid full discharge
Description: When the workshop secondary tablet's battery drops below 15%, rises above 70% or enters the 50–55% band, adjusts the screen only if it is on: below 15% sets brightness to 1 and turns the screen off, above 70% sets brightness to 99. A brightness-25 step meant for below 50% never runs, because the only trigger that could reach it fires between 50% and 55%.

Name: Control workshop Tablet charging
Description: Manages the workshop tablet's charging plug from its battery level. Crossing above 91% switches the plug off, right away between 09:00 and 23:00 or at 09:05 when it happens overnight; dropping below 29%, 25%, 15% or 10% switches the plug on and sets the screen brightness to 25. A 'below 16%: also turn the screen off' branch never runs because the below-30% branch always matches first.

Name: Copy Kitchen Assistant timer length on Cooking timer
Description: When the Kitchen Assistant's timer starts (its remaining-time sensor leaves 0.0) and the Cooking timer isn't already running, starts the Cooking timer for the same number of seconds, so it mirrors the assistant's timer.

Name: Dial Bedroom automation
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the bedroom dial. Each gesture targets media_player.bedroom_chromecast when it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise the bedroom Voice PE speaker: turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops (speaker -0.09/+0.06), a press plays/pauses, a double press skips track and a triple press turns that player off. Right turns test and raise media_player.universal_bedroom_chromecast instead.

Name: Dial hallway automation new
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the hallway dial, controlling only the hallway WiiM speaker. Turning left lowers the volume by 0.09 and turning right raises it by 0.06, repeating every 150 ms until the dial stops; a press plays/pauses, a double press skips to the next track and a triple press turns the speaker off.

Name: Dial Kitchen Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the kitchen dial. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on media_player.universal_kitchen_chromecast if it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise on the kitchen WiiM speaker (-0.09/+0.06). For presses the Chromecast must be playing or paused on non-Visuals content and not casting a Home Assistant dashboard (app A078F6B0), mute ignored: one plays/pauses, two skip track, three turn that player off.

Name: Dial Lounge Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the lounge Ganesha dial, controlling only the lounge WiiM speaker. Turning left lowers the volume by 0.09 and turning right raises it by 0.06, repeating every 150 ms until the dial stops; a press plays/pauses, a double press skips to the next track and a triple press turns the speaker off.

Name: Dial Lounge Tree Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the lounge tree dial, controlling only the lounge WiiM speaker. Turning right raises the volume by 0.06 every 150 ms until the dial stops, but turning left does nothing until rotation stops and then lowers it once by 0.09; a press plays/pauses, a double press skips to the next track and a triple press turns the speaker off.

Name: Dial Salon Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the salon desktop dial. Every gesture targets media_player.salon_chromecast when it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise the salon WiiM speaker: turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops (WiiM -0.09/+0.06), a press plays/pauses, a double press skips to the next track and a triple press turns that player off.

Name: Dial Salon window Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the salon window dial. Every gesture targets media_player.universal_salon_chromecast when it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise the salon WiiM speaker: turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops (WiiM -0.09/+0.06), a press plays/pauses, a double press skips to the next track and a triple press turns that player off.

Name: Dial Workshop Automation New
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the workshop wall dial. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on media_player.workshop_chromecast if it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise on the workshop WiiM speaker (-0.09/+0.06). Presses use the same test without the mute check: one plays/pauses, two skip to the next track and three turn that player off.

Name: Dial Workshop TV Automation
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the workshop TV dial, mapped the same as the workshop wall dial. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on media_player.workshop_chromecast if it is unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), otherwise on the workshop WiiM speaker (-0.09/+0.06). Presses use the same test without the mute check: one plays/pauses, two skip to the next track and three turn that player off.

Name: Dim budha if someone is watching TV in salon from bed
Description: When someone is detected in the salon bed zone (radar zone 2) or the salon TV starts playing, dims the Buddha statue lights to 1% over 2 seconds, provided those lights are on, the salon TV isn't off, the bed zone is occupied and the neon UV party is off.

Name: Dim Wall lights when workshop TV is playing and Beige couch or matress is occupied
Description: When the workshop couch/mattress radar zone (zone 2) becomes occupied or the workshop TV starts playing, dims the workshop wall light to 1% over 2 seconds, but only if the wall light is on, the TV is not off, the couch zone is occupied and neon UV party mode is off.

Name: Disable automatic back horn when Alarm system is disarmed
Description: Whenever the home alarm changes to disarmed and maximum back exit security is off, turns off 'Maxi is scared', the flag that arms the automatic back horn.

Name: Disable Automatic Back Horn when resident arrives
Description: When Maxi arrives home or Myriam's Wi-Fi-confirmed 'at Maxi's' sensor turns on after over 2 minutes away, while 'Maxi is scared' (automatic back horn mode) is on and maximum back exit security is off, waits up to 10 minutes for a person on the back door camera (else gives up). Then turns 'Maxi is scared' off and flashes the back door light green for 2 seconds, then white.

Name: Disarm alarm night when someone awakes
Description: When the All Residents Sleeping sensor turns from on to off, disarms the home alarm, but only if it is armed for the night and the sun is up (between sunrise and sunset); a wake-up before sunrise leaves it armed. A second trigger on sensor.is_maxi_asleep going 'asleep' to 'awake' never fires, because that sensor reports on/off.

Name: Disarm alarm when sun rises if everyone present is awake
Description: At sunrise, if the home alarm is armed in night mode and Maxi is not asleep (sensor.is_maxi_asleep off), disarms it. Despite the name, nobody else's sleep state is checked, and if Maxi is still asleep at sunrise it does nothing and does not retry later.

Name: Disarm alarm-away when "User Home" turns on
Description: When the Users Present sensor (binary_sensor.user_home) changes from off to on, meaning a resident has arrived home, disarms the home alarm, but only if it is currently armed away. Other alarm states, such as armed night, are left alone.

Name: Display lyrics on all screens
Description: Whenever the Show Lyrics toggle is flipped either way, turns off the salon Chromecast and then casts the hub dashboard's karaoke view to it. Despite the name, only the salon Chromecast is used, and turning the toggle off casts the view again rather than removing it.

Name: Display room color  on TVs when mimiclights mode is triggered
Description: Whenever the mimic-lights-on-screens toggle changes: turning it on casts the Color Hubs dashboard to every Chromecast, each showing the view for its own room (taken from its entity ID) so the TVs display the room's color; turning it off switches off any Chromecast that is playing Color Hubs.

Name: Doorbell Main automation
Description: Fires on any front doorbell button press or a doorbell-camera visitor, unless door_rang is already on. Sets door_rang, snapshots the front door camera, shows it picture-in-picture on the QuickBars TVs and broadcasts an important alert (blue light flash, spoken 'Someone is at the front door!', live stream on idle TVs, snapshot notification to Maxi's phone with unlock, reply and security-tab buttons). A neon UV party adds a second, red alert.

Name: Doorbell Show received notification answer on phone
Description: When Maxi types a reply into a doorbell notification (REPLY action on the doorbell_notifications channel; events from other users are ignored), copies the typed text into input_text.front_door_phone_text so the visitor can read it on the front door phone.

Name: Enable Following Music When all residents sleeping goes to ON after being OFF for over 1hour
Description: When the 'all residents sleeping' sensor turns on after having been off for more than an hour (everyone has fallen asleep after a real waking period, not a brief blip), turns music following on.

Name: Entrance hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the entrance Hue dial to light.group_entrance_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off entrance UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: execute Sleep actions when "sleeper in bedroom" is turned on
Description: Three seconds after the bedroom sleeper flag turns on, closes the bedroom blinds, fades out the lights, turns off the tablet screen and motion detection, and has Google Assistant turn off the bedroom TV. Starts the thunderstorm sound at 40% on the bedroom speaker unless it is already playing, house-sitting mode is on or the bedroom voice assistant's speaker is busy. Empty workshop, hallway and entrance areas also get their lights (and the workshop TV) turned off.

Name: Execute sleep actions when "Sleeper in closet" turns on
Description: When the closet sleeper flag turns on, fades the closet lights and closet string 2 off over 2 seconds and switches off the closet tablet's screen and its motion detection so the tablet stays dark.

Name: FRigate Arriving only Notification
Description: SgtBatten Frigate Notifications blueprint, front door camera: while the 'waiting for someone' toggle is on and the neighbours-party toggle is off, alerts Maxi's phone only when a person crosses the front-of-window, front-of-door and front-door loitering zones in that order (someone arriving). Its sticky 'Front Door Presence Detected' alert shows a snapshot and review video; tapping opens the live stream. Buttons: clip, live stream and front door horn (turns on its plug, replacing the blueprint's 30-minute snooze).

Name: Frigate back Doors Notifications
Description: SgtBatten Frigate Notifications blueprint, back door camera: when Frigate sees a person in the back entrance, hotbox window or back door zone and the back-yard party toggle is off, sends the users notification group a sticky 'Back door Presence Detected' alert with a snapshot, spoken once via TTS and silently updated as the event evolves. Buttons: clip, live stream and back door horn (turns on its plug, replacing the blueprint's 30-minute snooze).

Name: Frigate front Doors Notifications
Description: SgtBatten Frigate Notifications blueprint, front door camera: when Frigate sees a person in the front door loitering zone and the neighbours-party toggle is off, sends Maxi's phone a sticky 'Front Door Presence Detected' alert with a snapshot and preview video, silently updated as the event evolves. Buttons: clip, live stream and front door horn (turns on its plug, replacing the blueprint's 30-minute snooze). The 12 s loiter timer is unused by this blueprint version.

Name: Front door automation on unlock for conditional codes
Description: When guest code 6 is entered on the front door keypad with Maxi home: if the guest-unlock flag and party mode are both on, unlocks the door, shows a trilingual welcome on the door phone, flashes the lights blue and alerts Maxi with a camera snapshot, clearing the text once the door relocks; otherwise broadcasts 'Someone is at the front door!'. Its lock keypad sensors no longer exist, so it never runs.

Name: Front door automation on unlock for main codes
Description: When the front door lock (Schlage, via ZHA) reports a keypad unlock with code slot 3, 28, 4 or 5 (Maxi, Felix, Myriam or Lylou), disarms the home alarm, snapshots the front door PTZ camera and runs the important broadcast alert script, which announces the person by name ('is in the place') with cyan notification lights and sends Maxi's phone a high-priority 'has arrived' notification with the snapshot.

Name: hallway hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the hallway Hue dial to light.group_hallway_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off hallway UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: hotbox hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the hotbox Hue dial to light.group_hotbox_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off hotbox UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Hotbox LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the hotbox light group (light.group_hotbox_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Hotbox top Hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the hotbox top Hue dial to light.group_hotbox_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off hotbox UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Hotbox top ikea dial automation
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the hotbox tablet dial, a device the Workshop Tablet dial automation also listens to. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on media_player.hotbox_top_chromecast (right turns use universal_hotbox_top_chromecast) if unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), else the hotbox WiiM speaker (-0.09/+0.06). Presses drop the mute check: one plays/pauses, two skip track, three turn that player off.

Name: ikea Dial kitchen sink automation
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the kitchen sink dial, mapped like the kitchen dial. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on media_player.universal_kitchen_chromecast if unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), else the kitchen WiiM (-0.09/+0.06). For presses the Chromecast must be playing or paused on non-Visuals content and not casting a Home Assistant dashboard (app A078F6B0), mute ignored: one plays/pauses, two skip track, three turn that player off.

Name: Immediately mute bathroom speaker when door open and stuff is playing around
Description: As soon as the bathroom door opens, mutes the bathroom speaker (it keeps playing silently) if the kitchen or workshop speaker, or the kitchen or workshop Chromecast, is playing, so the bathroom audio doesn't compete with them.

Name: Immediately mute bathroom speaker when door open if all residents are sleeping
Description: When the bathroom door opens while the all-residents-sleeping sensor is on, immediately mutes the bathroom speaker (the Music Assistant bathroom VPE player) so nothing plays out loud while everyone sleeps.

Name: kitchen google display automation
Description: Keeps the kitchen Google Hub on its dashboard. When the hub's app changes and holds for 1 minute, or it has been paused for 10 minutes, and it is neither already showing a Home Assistant dashboard (cast apps A078F6B0 or 84912283) nor actively playing Plex (9AC194DC), turns the hub off, casts the kitchen-google-hub view of the lovelace-hub dashboard to it and sets its volume to 0.

Name: kitchen hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the kitchen Hue dial to light.group_kitchen_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off kitchen UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Kitchen LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the kitchen light group (light.group_kitchen_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Lock tablets on triggered alarm
Description: When the home alarm becomes triggered, turns on Fully Kiosk maintenance mode on the hallway, workshop, kitchen (S6 Lite) and closet tablets, locking their dashboards so an intruder can't use them to control the house.

Name: lounge hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the lounge Hue dial to light.group_lounge_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off lounge UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Lounge LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the lounge light group (light.group_lounge_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Lower lights to 30% when a movie is played
Description: When the bedroom, workshop or salon TV's universal Chromecast player starts or resumes playing (held 2 s) or switches its media type to movie (held 4 s), and the content is from the Movies library rather than a TV series, takes each light in that room that is on brighter than about 31% down to 30% at 3308 K with a 3-second fade.

Name: Lower loud volume when someone exits the shower
Description: When the bathroom radar's shower zone (zone 2) clears for 5 seconds while its zone 1 still detects someone and the shower is flagged as in use, lowers the bathroom Voice PE speaker to 67% if it is unmuted and set above 68%, so audio isn't too loud for someone stepping out of the shower.

Name: Lower sound when assist in progress
Description: When any of 12 voice satellites starts listening, lowers the first playing speaker in that satellite's room to about 65% of its volume and the first playing Chromecast there to half, in parallel. Once the satellite is idle again, or after 60 seconds, each is set back to its original volume unless someone changed it meanwhile. Activations during a run are ignored (single mode).

Name: Lower volume if police is detected in the front during a party
Description: During party mode, when the front door camera counts a person and average unmuted speaker volume exceeds 40%, asks LLM Vision if the camera shows a police officer or security guard; if yes, notifies Maxi with the image and lowers the hallway, workshop, kitchen, salon and lounge speakers to 30% and the home group to 28%. Its LLM Vision provider ID ends in a stray backslash, so that step likely fails.

Name: Manage House Sitting Mode when Maxi leaves/enters Montreal/home
Description: When Maxi leaves the zone around Montreal, turns house sitting mode on; when Maxi enters the home zone, turns it off again. There are no other conditions, so the mode simply follows Maxi's trips out of town and back.

Name: Music Assistant - Local(only) Voice Support Blueprint
Description: Music Assistant Local(only) Voice Support blueprint: handles local Assist commands like 'Play the album X by Y in the kitchen' or 'Shuffle the playlist X' (also tracks, artists, radio stations and audiobooks, optionally 'using radio mode'). Plays on the Music Assistant player or area named, else the asking device's area, else the whole-house speaker group (media_player.group_mass_home_group_speakers), turns shuffle on for 'Shuffle' requests and off otherwise, and replies with what's playing where.

Name: Mute all voice assistants while a concert is happening
Description: Once live concert mode has stayed on for 5 minutes, mutes every voice assistant through the assistants mute switch group, then unmutes them when live concert mode has been off for 5 minutes, or after 10 hours at the latest.

Name: Mute Bathroom Speaker Muzak v3
Description: When the bathroom door opens, or the bathroom has been empty for 5 seconds while the door is open, mutes the bathroom speaker: at once if the room is empty, any Chromecast is active, or the kitchen, workshop and hallway speakers are all playing; otherwise after the bathroom has stayed empty for 1 minute (if the bathroom speaker is the only active one) or 15 seconds, with up to two runs waiting at once.

Name: Mute bathroom speaker when door opens
Description: Once the bathroom door has been open for 5 seconds, mutes the bathroom speaker if the room is unoccupied. If someone is inside, sets it to 20% when no Chromecast TV is playing, mutes it when a TV is playing and only the bathroom has music, and otherwise waits up to 70 minutes for the bathroom to stay empty 15 seconds before muting. Re-opening the door restarts the run.

Name: Mute bathroom speaker when no motion and door open
Description: When the bathroom has shown no motion for 3 minutes and the bathroom door is open at that moment, mutes the bathroom speaker. If the door is closed then, it leaves the speaker as is.

Name: Mute chromecasts when they play PLEX visuals
Description: Whenever one of six universal Chromecast TVs (workshop, hotbox top, patio, bedroom, salon, kitchen) starts playing, changes title, changes mute state or switches to the Visuals library, mutes that TV if its active source is playing from the Plex 'Visuals' library and it isn't already muted. Because unmuting also triggers it, Visuals stay muted; the salon TV is only muted while the Bravia itself is on.

Name: Mute Kitchen hub if showing Home-Assistant and music playing in the kitchen
Description: Whenever the kitchen Music Assistant speaker changes and stays that way for 2 seconds, mutes the kitchen hub (the universal kitchen Chromecast player) if it is showing a Home Assistant dashboard cast app and is not already muted. Despite the name, it never checks that music is actually playing, so any speaker change, including stopping, can trigger it.

Name: Mute Kitchen hub when showing Home Assistant interface
Description: When the kitchen hub (the universal kitchen Chromecast player) switches to one of the two cast apps used to show Home Assistant dashboards, mutes the hub if it is not already muted.

Name: mute patio assistant when people are absent
Description: Mutes the patio voice assistant's microphone (turns its mute switch on) whenever the patio is empty, meaning patio motion is off and the patio camera counts zero people. It re-checks whenever patio motion changes, the person count drops to 0 or the mute switch itself changes, so unmuting it by hand while the patio is empty is undone immediately.

Name: Mute patio speaker when door closes
Description: When the patio door closes, mutes the patio speaker if nobody is in the patio standing zone, someone appears to have just come inside (server room motion or a person in the patio door zone) and party mode is off.

Name: Mute patio speaker when occupancy ends
Description: When patio motion has been off for 2 minutes, or whenever the patio speaker updates (state or attributes), mutes the patio speaker, provided Maxi's location sensor does not place Maxi on the patio and patio motion has been off for 2 minutes. During a back-yard party, the back-yard camera must also have seen no person for 5 minutes.

Name: Mute speaker in room if Myriam receives or makes call
Description: When Myriam starts talking on the phone while music following is on, it is meant to mute the playing room speaker players (IDs containing 'speakers') in the area named by the Bermuda zone sensor for Myriam's phone, wait for the call to end and unmute them. That sensor (sensor.bermuda_myriam_phone_bps_zone) no longer exists, only a renamed '_old' copy, so no speakers are found and nothing is muted.

Name: Mute speakers in room when Myriam's tablet starts jellyfin playback
Description: Triggered when Myriam's tablet changes room (held 2 s), not by Jellyfin playback as the name suggests. If music following is on and the tablet's universal player is playing, mutes the playing room speaker players (IDs containing 'speakers') in the tablet's new area; nothing here unmutes them.

Name: Mute speakers in rooms if myriam enters while talking
Description: Meant to mute music around Myriam during phone calls: when Myriam's phone changes room (sensor.bermuda_myriam_phone_bps_zone) while music following is on and Myriam is on a call, mutes the speakers playing in that room, then unmutes them once the phone has sat in another room for 20 seconds or the call ends. That Bermuda sensor no longer exists in the config or entity registry, so it never triggers.

Name: Mute speakers in the room if maxi uses a microphone
Description: When binary_sensor.maxi_is_talking turns on (Maxi is home and on a phone call or using the PC microphone), or Maxi changes room while it stays on, and music following is on, mutes the speakers playing in Maxi's current room. On a room change it also unmutes the playing speakers in the room just left, so the mute follows Maxi; nothing here unmutes when the talking stops.

Name: Mute speakers when the room is empty
Description: When one of eight rooms (closet, lounge, hallway, kitchen, workshop, workstation, salon or hotbox) has had no motion for 5 minutes, and music following is on and Maxi's tracked location isn't that room, mutes the Music Assistant speakers currently playing in that room. Playback continues silently rather than being paused.

Name: Nanoleaf actions control automation
Description: When the lounge Nanoleaf panel reports a swipe (up, down, left or right; its gesture entity is still named kitchen), runs 'Apply random existing effect to a light entity' to give the lounge Nanoleaf a different random effect. Because it watches the event_type attribute, repeating the same swipe doesn't retrigger it, while the panel coming back from unavailable does.

Name: Notify maxi when myriam arrives at home
Description: When Myriam's person entity goes from away to home after more than 4,000 seconds (about 67 minutes) away, notifies Maxi that Myriam is nearing home. If Myriam's phone isn't already on the Chilling Family or Chilling Hotspot Wi-Fi, it first waits up to 15 minutes for the phone to join one and sends nothing otherwise; a new arrival restarts that wait.

Name: Notify on potential package
Description: When Frigate spots a person or package at the front door while waiting_package is on, aims the PTZ camera at the package preset and asks LLM Vision whether a package or courier is visible. While the answer is yes, broadcasts a package-delivered alert with blue lights and rechecks every 5 minutes, keeping the camera on the doorway in between; a first 'no' leaves it on the package preset.

Name: Notify when someone leaves through front door
Description: When the front door lock reports unlocked while the front outside door is open (someone heading out), briefly flashes the notification lights that are on green as a low-priority alert, with no spoken announcement.

Name: Open bedroom blind in relation to bedroom ac
Description: Whenever the bedroom blind position changes or the bedroom AC plug turns on, sets the blinds to 19% if the plug is on and they are less than 19% open. This keeps a gap for the AC while it is powered, so anything that closes them (sunset, bedtime) ends at 19%.

Name: Open bedroom covers when the person awakes
Description: Once the bedroom sleeper flag has stayed off for 5 minutes after being on, opens the bedroom blinds, but only if the bedroom door has already been open for at least 10 minutes. If the door is closed or was opened more recently, the blinds are left as they are and nothing retries later.

Name: Open hotbox Blind in relation to AC
Description: Keeps the hotbox blinds at least 18% open while the hotbox AC has power: whenever the blinds move, close or start closing, the hotbox AC plug turns on, or the hotbox AC starts cooling, raises the blinds to 18% if they are open less than that and the hotbox AC plug is not off.

Name: Open phone to 911 number when smoke "call 911" notification is pressed
Description: When Maxi taps the "call 911" button (action open_phone_app_911) on a notification, such as the smoke alarm alert, sends a command_activity through Maxi's notification group that opens the Samsung dialer with 911 pre-filled, ready to call. Taps by other Home Assistant users are ignored.

Name: Open Salon Blind in relation to AC
Description: Keeps the salon blind at least 29% open while the salon AC could be running: whenever the blind moves, starts closing or closes, the AC plug turns on, or the salon AC starts cooling, sets the blind to 29% if it's below 29% and the AC plug isn't off (an unavailable plug also passes).

Name: Open workshop blind in relation to AC
Description: Whenever the workshop blind's position changes or the workshop AC plug turns on, opens the blind to 29% if the AC plug is on and the blind is less than 29% open, so it stays at least 29% open while the AC runs.

Name: Pause Music and Alert maxi in the room where he is when his phone rings
Description: When Maxi's phone rings, toggles play/pause on the home speaker group and has Piper announce 'Phone ringing near the <phone's Bermuda zone>' on the speaker in Maxi's current room (temporarily unjoined). If the phone goes idle within 20 minutes and Maxi is alone and not talking, plays Maxi's Smart Playlist on the home group via 'Start a random maxi playlist'; the follow-up Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment call does nothing (it passes speaker_id, not received_speaker).

Name: Play Muzak in the bathroom when someone enters
Description: When bathroom motion starts with the bathroom door open, and none of the bathroom, kitchen or workshop speakers or the workshop TV is playing, turns on shuffle and starts the Bathroom Muzak playlist on the bathroom speaker, replacing its queue. It then sets the volume to 10%, or to 40% if the door has closed by then.

Name: Play Random Music when maxi awakes at home
Description: When Maxi's asleep sensor has gone from on to off for 2 minutes between 07:00 and 11:59, while Maxi is home, not everyone is asleep and the Home Group speakers aren't playing, starts music on the Home Group. Before 11:00 with Myriam at Maxi's it plays Myriam Morning Music shuffled; otherwise the Start a random maxi playlist script plays Maxi's Smart Playlist (its default, not a random pick).

Name: Post-alarm disarm recovery actions
Description: When the alarm goes from triggered to disarmed, cleans up after the incident: stops playback and clears the queues on the home speaker group and the eight Music Assistant room speakers, turns off the back door, front door and parking horns, and turns the 'Turn on lights automatically' automation back on. The speaker and horn steps carry on past errors.

Name: Presence Simulation — Moving Random Lights
Description: Simulates someone moving through the empty house. When presence simulation turns on, the alarm arms away or the house empties (rechecked every 15 minutes) and all three hold, it turns off the 12 simulation light groups and lights a random one, then keeps moving to a different one every 5–118 minutes, overlapping both for 15–60 seconds, around the clock. Anyone arriving, the toggle turning off or the alarm leaving armed away turns its lights off and ends it.

Name: Purify Salon air when someone is smoking
Description: When the salon's 'Active Smoking' trend sensor turns on, switches on the salon air purifier plug. There are no conditions, and it never turns the purifier off itself.

Name: Quickly Turn off bathroom lights when motion ends or door open during UV party
Description: During a Neon UV Party, when the bathroom motion group or bathroom radar clears, or the bathroom door opens, fades the bathroom lights off over 5 seconds, but only if the bathroom door is open and the shower is not in use.

Name: Raise lights to 60% brightness when a movie is paused and the brightness is below 30%
Description: When the bedroom, workshop or salon TV is paused while playing something from the Movies library that isn't a TV-series episode, raises every light in that TV's room that is on below 60% brightness to 60% over 2 seconds. Despite the name's 30%, the threshold is 60%; several TVs can be handled in parallel (up to 6 runs).

Name: Raise music on the playing speaker when the Bathroom fans goes on
Description: When the bathroom fan turns on while the bathroom door is closed, raises the bathroom speaker's volume by two steps so music stays audible over the fan. Despite the name, it doesn't look for a playing speaker; it always targets the bathroom speaker, whether or not it is playing.

Name: Raise volume of speakers in a room when the vacuum is cleaning it
Description: When the Roborock's current-room sensor changes while the vacuum is cleaning, turns up by one step the Music Assistant speakers in that room that are playing and unmuted, then waits, with no time limit, for the vacuum to move to another room and turns those same speakers back down one step. Up to two runs overlap so each new room is handled as the last is restored.

Name: Raise volume when the AC starts in a room
Description: When the workshop AC, bedroom plug or hotbox AC switch goes from off to on, raises the volume one step on the Music Assistant speakers in that device's room that are playing and unmuted, to compensate for the AC noise. A fourth entry, the salon air purifier plug's reset button, never reports on/off, so it never fires.

Name: Re-enable adguard after 2 hours being off
Description: When the AdGuard protection switch group has been off for 1 hour, turns AdGuard protection back on. Despite the '2 hours' in the name, the actual delay is 1 hour.

Name: Re-lock doors 5 minutes after unlocking if door is shut
Description: Safety net for the door locks: when the front or back door lock has stayed unlocked for 5 minutes, re-locks it if that door's outside contact sensor shows the door closed. If the door is open at that moment it does nothing and does not retry; runs in parallel (up to 2), so each door is handled independently.

Name: Reboot patio projector when it goes offline
Description: When the patio projector light has been unavailable or unknown for 15 minutes, or its override plug has been on for 2 minutes while the projector is still offline, power-cycles the plug (off for 1 minute, then on), waits a minute and reloads the Matter integration. Since the plug coming back on re-arms the 2-minute trigger, it keeps retrying about every 3 minutes until the projector returns.

Name: Reload Hallway tablet start URL when occupancy of hallway goes to off for 5  minutes
Description: When the hallway has had no occupancy for 5 minutes, presses the hallway tablet's 'load start URL' button to send it back to its start page, unless Maxi is located in the hallway or the tablet is already showing the entrance dashboard's main view or the party page.

Name: Reload tablets 4 minutes after HA restarts
Description: When the Minutes since boot sensor (sensor.bootminutes) rises into the 3 to 5 minute window, about 4 minutes after a restart, presses the Load start URL button on nine kiosks (the hallway, hallway desk, workshop, closet, kitchen, bedroom, salon desk and server tablets plus the front door phone) so each reloads its start page. That sensor is no longer defined anywhere in the YAML (only a stale registry entry remains), so the trigger should never fire.

Name: Reload tablets when frigate changes state
Description: Whenever Frigate's status sensor changes and then holds its new state for 3 minutes, presses the 'load start URL' buttons on the hallway tablet and the salon desk tablet, reloading their start pages, presumably so their camera views reconnect after a Frigate restart.

Name: Reload workshop tablet start URL when occupancy of workshop goes to off for 5 minutes
Description: When the workshop motion occupancy group has been clear for 10 minutes (not 5 as the name says), presses the workshop tablet's 'load start URL' button to send it back to its start page. Skips this if Maxi's location sensor says workshop or the tablet is already on the workshop main view or the party page.

Name: Replace Spotify with Muzak playlist after 3.5 minutes
Description: When the bathroom door has been open for 5 minutes while the bathroom speaker is muted and nobody is in the bathroom, waits with no time limit until the bathroom is next occupied and then empty for 10 minutes. Then turns on shuffle and starts the 'Bathroom Muzak' playlist on the bathroom speaker, replacing its queue, and keeps it muted. A new trigger restarts the wait.

Name: Reset doorbell stuff on unlock
Description: When the front door lock has stayed locked for 45 seconds or unlocked for 45 minutes, or either doorbell rang flag has been on for 4 minutes, turns off the door rang, door double-rang and waiting-for-someone flags and resets the front door phone text to 'Empty', re-arming the main doorbell alert. Despite the name, a fresh unlock does nothing until 45 minutes have passed.

Name: Restore patio lights when projector turns off
Description: When the patio projector light has been off for 2 seconds, recolors whichever patio lights are on to suit the active mode (checked in this order): random pastel colors in party mode, warm pale colors during a kink party, or fully saturated random colors during Acid Time, each via the matching 'Change received lights' script. Otherwise re-applies Adaptive Lighting to the patio lights over 1 second.

Name: Return PTZ to doorway after 10 minutes
Description: Whenever a select_option service call targets the front door PTZ camera's preset selector, waits 10 minutes and sets the preset back to 'doorway'; a new call restarts the timer. Its own reset is also a matching call, so once triggered it keeps re-triggering itself and re-sends 'doorway' every 10 minutes until the automation is reloaded or Home Assistant restarts.

Name: revert Lounge Door Arch effect to solid color when All residents Present Sleeping is on for 4 hours
Description: When all residents present have been asleep for 4 hours, or have been awake again for 20 minutes, and neither the lounge nor the salon sleeper flag is on, puts the door LED arch (light.salon_door_leds) back on its plain Solid effect at 3086 K and brightness 1, then turns the arch off.

Name: Ring horn in the back if someone tries to approach while maxi is scared
Description: With 'Maxi is scared' mode or maximum back exit security on, or the alarm armed for vacation, a person at the back entrance or back door sets off the back door horn and the back door camera's siren, with the camera cast to the bedroom, workshop, hotbox and salon Chromecasts and the kitchen hub. Horn and siren stop once the camera's person sensor goes clear for 15 seconds, or after 5 minutes.

Name: salon hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the salon Hue dial to light.group_salon_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off salon UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Salon LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the salon light group (light.group_salon_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Salon Window Hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the salon window Hue dial to light.group_salon_lights.
