Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off salon UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: Set front door screen text
Description: When anyone answers a phone notification with the REPLY action, turns on the front door phone's screen and shows the typed reply there (via input_text.front_door_phone_text). After 5 minutes the text resets to 'Empty'; the screen then turns off once the front door camera stops seeing a person, or after at most 10 more minutes. A new reply restarts the whole sequence.

Name: Set Salon TV to Retro gaming station when a paired controller turns on
Description: When the paired Batocera game controller turns on and the salon Chromecast (universal player) is not playing, runs the 'Start retro gaming session' script, which powers on the salon TV and switches it to HDMI 1, the retro console input.

Name: Set the kitchen hub volume to 100% on app launch
Description: Each time the kitchen Google Hub switches to playing and its current app is Plex, sets the hub's volume to 80%. The name says 100%, but the code sets 0.8.

Name: Set Wallpaper engine colors to match the lights
Description: When the salon light group's RGB color changes and holds for 2 seconds while the lights are on, converts the color to 0–1 values and publishes eight Wallpaper Engine commands over MQTT to Maxi's desktop PC (DESKTOP_MAXI), setting the wallpaper's scheme color, wave colors, e9 colors 1–4 and "apple" property to match.

Name: Show main screen when music stops on Hallway tablet
Description: When the home speaker group has been off for 1 minute and the hallway tablet is still on the music subview (with or without the camera-motion anchor), presses the tablet's load-start-URL button to send it back to its start page.

Name: Skips song's myriam don't like whe she is home
Description: Whenever the track title changes on any of seven Music Assistant room speakers or the home group while Myriam is at Maxi's, skips that player to the next track if the title is 'Mr. Blue Sky' or 'Mr Blue Sky'. Only exact titles match: the template cuts the title at '(' but keeps the trailing space, so bracketed versions are not skipped.

Name: Sleep actions when "all resident sleeping" is turned on
Description: When all residents have been asleep for 5 minutes, or the home alarm is armed for the night, and the sun is down with no kink party, Acid Time or party mode on, turns on Adaptive Lighting sleep mode. It also closes the workshop, salon and hotbox blinds and the kitchen curtains, and turns off the Workshop Google TV and the Salon Sony Bravia TV.

Name: Sleep actions when "maxi is sleeping" is turned on anywhere
Description: Once Maxi has been asleep (sensor.is_maxi_asleep on) for 5 minutes, sends companion-app commands through Maxi's notification group to set the phone's Do Not Disturb to priority only and lower its screen brightness to level 5.

Name: Sleep actions when "sleeper in hotbox" is turned on
Description: When the "sleeper in hotbox" flag turns on, unjoins the hotbox WiiM speaker from any group, closes the hotbox blinds and bed door cover, and fades off over 10 seconds every light in the hotbox area plus the hotbox light group, the server assistant screen and the Seeed heartbeat sensor's RGB light. It then turns off both hotbox tablet screens, the hotbox Roku, and the tablet screens again.

Name: Sleep actions when "sleeper in patio" is turned on
Description: When the patio sleeper flag turns on (someone is sleeping on the patio), turns off the patio light group and every other light in the Patio area with a 2-second transition.

Name: Sleep actions when "sleeper in workshop" is turned on
Description: When the workshop sleeper flag turns from off to on, mutes the workshop and hallway speakers, closes the workshop blinds, turns off the LG workshop TV, every WorkShop-area light and both workshop assistant screens, and dims both workshop tablets to brightness 1 before switching off their screens and motion detection. Finally it sends Google Assistant the command 'Power off workshop TV' as a backup TV shutoff.

Name: Sleeper actions when salon sleeper turns on
Description: When the salon sleeper flag turns on, fades out the salon lights, closes the salon blinds, and turns off both salon assistant screens and the desk tablet screen. Turns off the hallway light if the entrance is empty, the lounge lights if the lounge is empty, and the salon TV via RS-232 if it is on. If Maxi or Myriam is in the salon, plays the thunderstorm sound on the salon speaker at 46%.

Name: slowly return lights to blue during NEON UV Party
Description: During a Neon UV Party, 10 seconds after any change to one of the room light groups (bedroom, entrance, salon, server, hotbox, lounge, workshop, kitchen, hallway, patio, closet) or the front door light, including being turned off or recolored, fades that light back to full-brightness blue over 2 minutes. Runs in parallel, up to 10 lights at once.

Name: Speaker Automatic Volume v4
Description: When any of eight Music Assistant speakers goes from idle to playing after 5+ idle minutes, or turns on after 30+ seconds off, runs the Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script for it in parallel (time-of-day volume, re-muted if its room has no motion). Requires music following on, neither broadcast alert script running, and no "thunderstorm" title. The unmute trigger compares to text 'true'/'false', not booleans, so never fires.

Name: Speaker/Chromecast Mutual Mute Management
Description: While music following is on, keeps one audible source per room: a TV/Chromecast that starts playing or is unmuted mutes the room's playing speakers, and vice versa (the salon TV is muted only while the Sony is on). Muted active sources are unmuted once the other kind has nothing audible left in the room, provided it has motion and no sleeper; most play-state changes also require the previous state to have lasted over 10 minutes.

Name: Start bathroom fan when Shower in Usage turns on
Description: When the Shower in Usage sensor has been on for 30 seconds, turns on the bathroom fan. There are no conditions, and nothing here turns the fan back off.

Name: Start bathroom muzak when door closes
Description: Each time the bathroom door closes while the bathroom speaker isn't already playing, turns on shuffle and starts the 'Bathroom Muzak' playlist on that speaker through Music Assistant (replacing its queue), then sets the volume to 40%. There is no time-of-day check.

Name: Start music when maxi returns home
Description: When Maxi has been home for 3 minutes after being away (coming from not_home, not another zone), and Maxi is alone and the home speaker group is off, plays 'All favorited tracks' on the home speaker group through Music Assistant, replacing the queue.

Name: Start rain sounds where maxi is sleeping
Description: When Maxi's sleeping location (sensor.where_is_maxi_sleeping) changes while Maxi is home and alone, picks the first Music Assistant speaker in that room and, unless it is already playing 'thunderstorm', unjoins it from any group, plays the thunderstorm rain track and unmutes it. Either way the speaker ends at 42% volume. Nothing happens if the location is blank or unknown or the room has no such speaker.

Name: Start turning lights on before maxi's alarm rings on week days for work
Description: On weekdays, two minutes before Maxi's next phone alarm, if that moment falls between 07:30 and 09:30, fades the light groups (except UV lamps) in the room where Maxi currently is, per the petro_v2 location sensor, to 51% at 3311 K over 10 minutes. It then waits 45 minutes so snoozed alarms can't retrigger it (mode single).

Name: Start visuals on all inactive TVs
Description: When the Start Visuals button is pressed, runs the Plex visual-playlist script (script.start_visual_playlist_on_plex) with the All Visuals playlist, which starts it shuffled and muted on every Chromecast and Google Hub that is off, skipping bedroom Chromecasts and rooms with sleepers. It waits for the script to finish, so presses during a run are ignored.

Name: Stop bedroom speaker when bedroom sleeper awake
Description: When the bedroom sleeper flag (input_boolean.sleeper_in_bedroom) goes from on to off and stays off for 6 minutes, clears the queue on the bedroom Voice PE speaker and turns the speaker off, so sleep music stops once the sleeper is up. There are no conditions, so whatever is playing there at that point is stopped.

Name: Stop home group when maxi leaves
Description: Once Maxi has been away from home for 5 minutes, if the Music Assistant home speaker group isn't off, clears its queue and turns the whole group off.

Name: Stop parking horns when "stop parking horn" notification is received
Description: When anyone taps the 'stop parking horn' action on a phone notification, turns off the parking horn plug (continuing even if that fails) and the parking exit camera's siren.

Name: Stop thunderstorm sound when bedroom awakes
Description: Five minutes after the bedroom sleeper flag turns off, if the bedroom speaker's media title still contains 'thunderstorm', clears its queue and turns it off. This backs up the 5-second wake-up automation, which only stops the sound on an exact title match.

Name: Tell maxi about the weather when he awakes
Description: Would send Maxi's notification group a 'Current Weather' message (Montreal weather condition plus outside temperature) 5 minutes after Maxi wakes, if Maxi is home between 06:45 and 10:00. In practice it never fires: the trigger waits for sensor.is_maxi_asleep to read 'awake', but that template sensor only outputs 'on' or 'off'.

Name: Tell maxi when his watch is charged
Description: When the battery level of Maxi's watch changes to 100% while the watch's battery state reads charging or full, sends Maxi's notification group 'Your watch is charged!' under the title 'Watch Alert'.

Name: Toggle sleeper in bedroom on button press
Description: When the 'on' button of the bedroom sleeper button (an IKEA TRADFRI shortcut button on ZHA) is double-pressed, toggles the bedroom sleeper flag, which drives the bedroom bedtime and wake-up automations.

Name: Trigger all home defense script through notification
Description: When anyone taps a notification action named trigger_all_alerts on a phone, runs the All on defense script (script.in_home_defense_script), which rings Maxi's phone, notifies Maxi and Myriam, turns on the front and back door horns and blares a burglar alarm at full volume on the house speakers. There is no restriction on which user taps it.

Name: Trigger back horn when someone loiters for too long at the door
Description: After someone loiters at the back door for 1 minute while the alarm is neither disarmed nor armed home and there is no back-yard party, turns on the back door horn, runs Find phone to ring Maxi's phone and sends Maxi a high-priority alert with a back door camera image. The horn stops once the camera sees no person for 30 seconds, or after 15 minutes; re-triggers are ignored meanwhile.

Name: Trigger front horn through phone notification
Description: When anyone taps a notification action named blow_front_horn on a phone, turns on the front door security horn plug (switch.plug_front_door_horn). Any user's tap counts, and nothing in this automation turns the horn back off afterwards.

Name: Trigger In home defense script through phone notification
Description: When a 'Blare inside alert?' notification button (action trigger_inside_alert) is tapped from Maxi's account or one other allowed user account, runs the Inside only home defense script, which turns off music following and blares a burglar alarm at full volume on the home speakers until the security occupancy sensors have been clear for 5 minutes. Taps from other users are ignored.

Name: Trigger in-home defense script after the alarm is triggered for 3 continuous minutes
Description: Once the home alarm has stayed triggered for 5 minutes (not 3 as the name says) and the Multi Room Security Motion sensor still shows at least two security sensors detecting someone, runs the All on defense script: it rings Maxi's phone, notifies Maxi and Myriam, turns on the front and back door horns and blares a burglar alarm at full volume on the house speakers.

Name: Trigger initial Speaker volume script when Following Music turns on
Description: When music following turns on, lists the Music Assistant speakers (entity IDs containing 'speaker' but not 'home') that are playing and unmuted and passes them to the Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script. The script only uses the first one: it sets the time-of-day volume, unmutes it, then re-mutes it if its room has no active motion; nothing happens if none are playing.

Name: Trigger kinky ambiance script when kinky party turns on
Description: When Kink Party switches from off to on, runs the Set whole house to kinky ambiance script, which gives the inside lights that are on warm pale colors, starts the Kinky Time visuals playlist on idle TVs, plays the Kinky Time music playlist if the speakers are off, and closes all blinds.

Name: Trigger parking siren for 1 seconds if someone is loitering by the car
Description: Every 30 seconds for up to 5 minutes while a person lingers at the parking exit, if the parking camera sees a car, Myriam is at Maxi's and no back-yard party is on, snapshots the exit camera and asks LLM Vision whether the person is interacting with the car. On a yes, turns the exit floodlight on full, chirps the camera siren for half a second and alerts Maxi with a parking-horn button.

Name: Trigger party script when party mode turns on
Description: When Party Mode switches from off to on, runs the Set whole house to party ambiance script, which closes the blinds, puts the lights on random pastel colors with LIFX and LED effects, starts background visuals on idle TVs and can start the party playlist on idle speakers.

Name: Trigger patio drinking game lights on voice command
Description: When someone says one of seven drinking-game phrases to Assist, such as 'who should drink' or 'pick a drinker on the patio', runs the Patio Drinking Game Light Effect script: the patio lights go dim red, one random light turns bright green, and the patio lights are restored after 10 seconds.

Name: Trigger police announcement on triggered alarm
Description: When the home alarm becomes triggered, sends Maxi and Myriam an 'Intruder Alert' with a Frigate snapshot and a 'Blare inside alert?' button, turns off music following and the inside, whole-house and patio light groups, and plays the police de-escalation announcement at 100% on the home speaker group. Afterwards it unmutes seven room speakers, sets them to full volume, and stops the speaker group 30 seconds later.

Name: Trigger psychedelic script when acid mode turns on
Description: When Acid Time switches from off to on, runs the Set whole house to psychedelic ambiance script: random fully saturated colors on the lights that are on, the LIFX morph effect, 4K visuals on idle TVs, psychedelic music if the speakers are idle, and blinds closed while the sun is up.

Name: Trigger Update of the Eink Day Brief display
Description: At 06:00, or when button 1 on the OpenDisplay e-ink screen is held for 5 seconds, draws the full daily briefing (3-day agenda, outside temperature and an AI-written news story) on it; a short press instead draws the 7-day agenda-only view on release. Because it runs in single mode, the release after a long hold is ignored while the full briefing is still drawing.

Name: Trippy Light Warm Random Colors Effect automation (Script call)
Description: While the trippy warm colors toggle is on and the regular trippy effect is off, keeps giving every lit color light (all-lights group, not in color-temperature mode) a new red/magenta/purple hue via 'Change received lights to warm saturated colors' at the trippy saturation and speed, waiting twice the fade time per round. Once the toggle is off, it finishes the round and re-applies Adaptive Lighting unless the regular trippy effect took over; speed changes restart it.

Name: Turn ACs on and Off  depending on house occupancy
Description: Whenever the Users Present sensor changes, sets the workshop and salon ACs to the 'none' preset if someone is home and to the 'away' preset if nobody is. Despite the name, it never turns the ACs on or off; it only switches their preset mode.

Name: Turn Assist screens on when listening
Description: When any of nine voice assistants (kitchen, saloon, lv, bedroom, desktop, lounge, bathroom, patio, server) starts listening, turns that device's own light (its screen/LED) on at 100%, unless the device's room is listed in the active sleeper rooms sensor (Hotbox Top/Down count as Hotbox).

Name: Turn back door lights on when someone is detected
Description: When any of four back-entrance person detectors turns on (Frigate's back door camera, back entrance presence and hotbox window presence detections, or the Reolink back door camera's person sensor), turns the back door light on at full brightness and 3724 K. It works at any time of day and never turns the light off itself.

Name: Turn camera to doorway on doorbell action
Description: Whenever the front doorbell button gets a short press, double press or long release, turns the front door PTZ camera to its 'doorway' preset so it looks at the visitor. There are no conditions; triple presses and the start of a long press don't move it.

Name: Turn down volume when AC goes off
Description: When the workshop AC, bedroom plug, hotbox AC or salon AC switch goes from on to off, lowers the volume one step on the Music Assistant speakers in that device's room that are playing and unmuted, mirroring the raise applied when an AC starts. Only this half covers the salon AC; the raise side's salon entry is a reset button that never fires.

Name: Turn light on when someone is detected in the front
Description: A person detected by the front door camera turns the front door light to full-brightness 4628 K white; once no one has been seen for 3 minutes (1 hour at most), it goes back off, or back to its saved brightness and color if it was on. A re-detection mid-wait restarts the run and saves the bright white as the state to restore, leaving the light on bright white.

Name: Turn lights back to normal when UV lamps are turned off
Description: When a room's UV lamp group (hallway, kitchen, lounge, patio, workshop or salon) goes from on to off, recolors that room's lights that are on to match the house mode: random pastels in party mode, warm pale colors during a kink party, or fully saturated random colors during Acid Time, checked in that order. With none of those active, it reapplies Adaptive Lighting to the room's light groups.

Name: Turn lights to white when we stop a movie
Description: When the salon or workshop TV turns off (from playing, paused or idle) and it wasn't showing a TV-series episode, with no kink party, party mode, Acid Time or live concert on, resets each lit light in that TV's room: stops its effect if supported, then re-applies Adaptive Lighting brightness and color over 2 seconds. The Movies-only check is disabled, so any non-series content counts.

Name: Turn off 'Sleeper in X' switch when lights are on and bright in the room for 7 minutes
Description: When the salon, hotbox, bedroom, lounge, closet or patio light group has stayed above brightness 60 (about 24%) for 7 minutes, turns off any of that room's 'Sleeper in X' booleans that are on, treating the bright lights as a sign the room is no longer being slept in. Nothing happens if the room has no active sleeper flag.

Name: Turn off acid time when everyone goes to bed
Description: Once everyone has been detected asleep for 30 minutes (binary_sensor.all_residents_sleeping on for 30 min), turns off the Acid Time mode boolean if it is still on.

Name: Turn off air purifier in salon when smoke is gone
Description: When the PM1 (particles under 1 µm) reading of the salon Apollo AIR-1 drops below 10, turns off the salon air purifier plug, regardless of what turned it on.

Name: Turn off Assists screens when done listening
Description: When one of five voice assistants (kitchen, saloon, lv, bedroom, desktop) finishes processing or returns to idle, turns that device's own light (screen/LED) off, but only if its room is listed in the active sleeper rooms sensor, so screens stay dark where someone sleeps.

Name: Turn off Back camera siren when back horn goes off
Description: Whenever the back door horn plug goes from on to off, also turns off the Reolink back door camera's siren, so stopping the horn silences both deterrents.

Name: Turn off back horn when maxi is scared is disabled
Description: When 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn mode) turns off and the back door horn plug is currently on, switches the horn off so it doesn't keep sounding once the mode is disabled.

Name: Turn off Bathroom fan when humidity falls
Description: When the bathroom humidity sensor drops below the house's average humidity (sensor.average_house_humidity), turns off the bathroom fan switch. It reacts only to that downward crossing and has no other conditions.

Name: Turn off cameras on screens when door is locked back
Description: When the front door goes from unlocked to locked, or the door-rang or door-double-rang flag has stayed on for 4 minutes, finds every Cast player with 'chromecast' in its ID that is running the DashCast app (used to put cameras on the screens) and turns it off.

Name: Turn off Closet fan after 5 minutes of non occupancy
Description: When the closet's motion group has gone from occupied to clear and stayed clear for 10 minutes, turns off the closet fan plug. The name says 5 minutes, but the trigger actually waits 10.

Name: Turn off front door screen if it remains open 10 minutes
Description: Safety timeout for the front door phone: once its screen has stayed on for 10 straight minutes, turns it off, whether or not someone is still at the door, to limit battery drain.

Name: Turn off front door screen on clear of occupancy
Description: Once the front door camera has stopped detecting a person for 1 minute (person occupancy on to off), turns off the front door phone's screen if it is still on, helping save the phone's battery.

Name: Turn off Hotbox bed fan when curtain opens
Description: When the hotbox bed's side curtain opens past 50%, turns off the hotbox bed ventilation fan plug if it is on, undoing the fan that comes on when the curtain closes.

Name: Turn off Jukebox Access during Live Concert
Description: Once live concert mode has been on for 10 seconds, calls 'Reset Tablet Endpoint interface' for the hallway, kitchen and workshop tablets, whose Fully Kiosk browsers restart and drop the party jukebox page. A trailing 5-hour wait has no triggers, so it does nothing but keep the run active.

Name: Turn off lights automatically when room is empty and sleep mode is on
Description: When any of ten rooms (patio, closet, lounge, server, hallway, kitchen, entrance, workshop, workstation or salon) has shown no motion for 1 minute, turns off all lights in that room with a 60-second fade. Only runs while Adaptive Lighting sleep mode is on and party mode, kink party and Acid Time are all off; checks for Maxi or Myriam being in the room are disabled.

Name: Turn off lights colors adaptation when an event is ongoing
Description: When Kink party, Party mode or Acid Time switches on, turns off Adaptive Lighting's 'adapt color' switch so the event's custom light colors aren't overridden, leaving brightness adaptation untouched. The companion 'Turn on color adaptation when events end' automation switches it back on afterwards.

Name: Turn off lights when a room is empty and sleep mode is off V2
Description: When any of ten rooms (patio, closet, lounge, server, hallway, kitchen, entrance, workshop, workstation, salon) has had no occupancy for 6 minutes, turns off every light in that room's area, unless Maxi is in that room (or Maxi's location is unknown), party mode, kink party, neon UV party or Acid Time is on, or Adaptive Lighting sleep mode is on. Rooms are handled in parallel.

Name: Turn off lights when the house is empty
Description: When zone.home's person count drops to zero and stays there for 5 minutes, meaning every tracked person has left, turns off all inside lights via light.group_all_inside_lights. It has no conditions and fires once per transition to an empty house.

Name: Turn off Maxi is Scared when all residents sleeping turns off during daytime
Description: When the 'all residents sleeping' sensor turns off (not everyone is asleep any more) while the sun is above the horizon and maximum back exit security is off, turns off 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn mode).

Name: Turn off parking light 5 minutes after it turns on if there's no person presence
Description: Once the parking lamp has been on for 5 minutes, turns it off right away if the parking occupancy group is clear. If instead the parking or parking exit camera still sees a person, waits with no time limit until the parking has been clear for 5 minutes, then turns it off. If the group shows occupancy but neither camera sees a person, nothing happens.

Name: Turn off Parking light on 5 minutes of no occupancy
Description: When the parking occupancy group sensor goes from occupied to clear and stays clear for 5 minutes, turns off the parking lamp. No other conditions apply.

Name: Turn off patio lights at sunset when patio is empty
Description: At sunset, if the patio occupancy group reports nobody there, turns off the patio light group. If someone is on the patio at sunset, the lights are left alone and nothing retries later.

Name: Turn off Phone Bluetooth emitter when maxi leaves home
Description: Whenever Maxi's person entity changes to not_home (away), sends a companion-app command to Maxi's phone to turn off its BLE (Bluetooth beacon) transmitter while Maxi is away, saving battery.

Name: Turn off Salon Tv when no one is in front of it for 20 minutes
Description: When salon radar zone 2 (in front of the TV) has been empty for 20 minutes and the salon Chromecast is not playing, turns off the salon Sony Bravia TV through its remote entity.

Name: Turn off sleep mode for adaptative lighting when myriam awakes
Description: Intended to switch off Adaptive Lighting sleep mode 5 minutes after Myriam wakes, if Myriam's person entity is in the home zone. The trigger waits for sensor.is_myriam_asleep to change from 'asleep' to 'awake', but that template sensor only ever reports 'asleep' or 'on', so it never fires.

Name: Turn off sleeper in bedroom when lights turns on
Description: When the bedroom chandelier has stayed brighter than 80 of 255 (about 31%) for 2 minutes, turns off the bedroom sleeper flag (input_boolean.sleeper_in_bedroom), treating a brightly lit bedroom as a sign that whoever slept there is up.

Name: Turn off sleeper in salon when lights are bright
Description: When the salon lights group has stayed above brightness 80 of 255 (about 31%) for 2 minutes, turns off the 'sleeper in salon' flag, treating bright lights as a sign that nobody is sleeping there anymore.

Name: Turn off Sleeping mode for Adaptative lighting on "all resident sleeping" turns off
Description: When the all-residents-sleeping sensor has been off for 3 minutes, turns off Adaptive Lighting sleep mode, but only between 08:00 and 22:00 on weekdays or 10:00 and 22:00 on weekends. If the sensor turns off outside those windows, nothing happens and sleep mode stays on, since nothing re-checks later.

Name: Turn off speakers after 1 minutes of pause
Description: Shuts down idle Music Assistant players: once any of the eight room speakers (WiiMs in the lounge, hallway, workshop, salon, kitchen and patio; VPE speakers in the closet and bedroom) or the whole-home group has been paused or idle for 10 minutes, it clears that player's queue and turns it off. Despite the name, the wait is 10 minutes, not 1.

Name: Turn off the front door light in relation to the sun position
Description: Fifteen minutes after sunrise (once the sun has been above the horizon for 15 minutes), fades the front door light off over 5 minutes, every day with no other conditions.

Name: Turn off trippy lights after 16 continous hours
Description: Safety timeout for the trippy light effects: turns off the trippy lights effect once it has stayed on for 16 hours straight, and the trippy warm colors effect once it has stayed on for 16 hours 16 minutes.

Name: Turn off UV vibes when Neon Uv Party ends
Description: When the Neon UV Party toggle has been off for 5 seconds, opens all blinds (including the bedroom and hotbox ones) if the sun is up, and turns the mains Adaptive Lighting switch back on and all UV lamps off. Its final Adaptive Lighting apply on the all, inside and entrance light groups disables both brightness and color adaptation, so the integration skips it and it changes nothing.

Name: Turn off water utilities when leak detected
Description: As soon as the dishwasher's water leak detector reports moisture, or its second 'Opening' moisture sensor turns on, turns off the kitchen dishwasher and washer plugs to stop further water use.

Name: Turn off workshop lights when bedroom Sleeper turns on
Description: When the bedroom sleeper sensor goes from off to on and the workshop motion group reports no occupancy, fades out every light in the WorkShop area, plus the workshop light group, over 20 seconds so an empty workshop isn't left lit while someone sleeps.

Name: Turn off Workshop sleeper when lights are bright
Description: When the workshop lights group has stayed above brightness 70 of 255 (about 27%) for 2 minutes, turns off the 'sleeper in workshop' flag, treating bright lights as a sign that nobody is sleeping there anymore.

Name: Turn on Automatic back Horn upon receiving notification answer
Description: When the 'Turn it back on' button is tapped on the 'Automatic Back Horn Disabled' phone notification (mobile app action turn_automatic_back_horn_on), turns 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn mode) back on, with no other checks.

Name: Turn on back door light when door opens
Description: When the back outside door opens, turns the back door light on at 100% brightness and a neutral-white 4882 K. It runs at any time of day and nothing here turns the light back off.

Name: Turn on back door light when resident arrives through parking
Description: When Maxi arrives home or Myriam's Wi-Fi-confirmed at-Maxi's sensor turns on, after more than 5 minutes away, waits up to 10 minutes for a person to appear on either parking camera, then turns the back door light on at full brightness in white (3726 K). If nobody is seen it gives up, and a new arrival restarts the wait.

Name: Turn on Blue Light with UV Lamps in Same Area
Description: When a room's UV lamp group (hallway, kitchen, lounge, patio, workshop or salon) goes from off to on and no live concert is running, runs 'Change received lights to blue' for that room, turning every color-capable light there, including ones that were off, bright blue at 100% with a 1-second fade.

Name: Turn on camera floodlight when someone is detected and maxi is scared is on
Description: When the hotbox window or back entrance presence sensor, or the Reolink back door camera, detects a person while both 'Maxi is scared' mode and maximum back exit security are on, turns the back door camera's floodlight on at full brightness. Nothing here turns it back off.

Name: Turn on color adaptation when events end
Description: When Kink party, Party mode or Acid Time switches off and all three are now off, turns Adaptive Lighting's 'adapt color' switch back on so lights resume automatic color adjustment. If any of the three is still on, nothing happens; the last one to switch off re-enables it.

Name: Turn on front door screen on occupancy
Description: When the front door camera starts detecting a person and the front door phone's screen is off, turns that screen on so the display lights up for whoever is at the door.

Name: Turn on Hotbox Bed ventilation fan when side curtain closes
Description: When the hotbox bed's side curtain closes, detected either as its position dropping below 5% or as it staying closed for a minute, turns on the hotbox bed ventilation fan plug if it is off.

Name: Turn on Jukebox Public queue when party mode turns on
Description: When party mode turns on with no live concert running, or when live concert mode switches off while party mode is still on, runs 'Launch Party Mode Jukebox on All Kiosks', which loads the Music Assistant party jukebox page on the kitchen and workshop tablets.

Name: Turn on lights automatically
Description: When motion starts in one of eleven rooms (not the bedroom or hotbox) or in hallway radar zone 3 (the wardrobe), turns on each light in that room that is off, skipping lights labeled High Intensity Light. It skips rooms with an active sleeper and does nothing while the alarm is armed away or triggered; there is no time-of-day or light-level check.

Name: Turn on Maxi is scared upon alarm arming away
Description: When the home alarm is armed away and nobody is home (the home zone is empty, or its only occupant is Myriam by GPS while the Wi-Fi-based 'Myriam at Maxi's' sensor isn't on), turns on 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn mode).

Name: Turn on Maxi is scared when Alarm is armed night
Description: When the home alarm is armed in night mode between 21:00 and 08:00, turns on the 'Maxi is scared' flag (input_boolean.maxi_is_scared). Arming night mode outside those hours leaves the flag unchanged.

Name: Turn on Maxi is scared when All Residents are sleeping
Description: When all residents have been detected as sleeping for 5 minutes and the time is between 21:30 and 08:00, turns on 'Maxi is scared' (the automatic back horn security mode).

Name: Turn on parking horn when back door horn runs for over 1 minute with presence detected
Description: When the back door horn has been sounding for a full minute and a person is still detected at the back entrance, escalates by turning on the parking horn as well.

Name: Turn on Parking Infrared when Parking Exit infrared goes off
Description: Turns on the Reolink parking camera's night-mode infrared switch as a fallback for the parking exit camera: whenever the exit camera's day/night sensor changes to day, unavailable or unknown, or the exit camera's own night-mode infrared switch goes from on to off.

Name: Turn on parking light on any parking/balcony activity
Description: Turns on the parking lamp whenever any of the four parking person detectors fires, a person is detected at the back entrance or by the Reolink back door camera, or either parking camera has seen a car for 3 seconds. There is no darkness or time-of-day check; turning it off is left to other automations.

Name: Turn on party mode when over 5 guests are over
Description: When the number of clients on the Chilling Hotspot Wi-Fi rises above 5, turns on party mode, unless a kink party, Acid Time or a neon UV party is already on. It only ever turns party mode on; nothing here turns it back off when guests leave.

Name: Turn on Phone Bluetooth emitter when maxi arrives home
Description: Whenever Maxi's person entity changes to home, sends a companion-app command to Maxi's phone to turn on its BLE (Bluetooth beacon) transmitter, which is used for room-level presence tracking at home.

Name: Turn on sleeper in bedroom boolean when sensor turns to on
Description: When the bedroom sleeper sensor (binary_sensor.sleeper_in_bedroom) changes from off to on, turns on the matching bedroom sleeper flag, input_boolean.sleeper_in_bedroom, which feeds Maxi's sleep detection. The sync is one-way: nothing here turns the flag off again.

Name: Turn on Sleeper in Hotbox on button press
Description: When the hotbox sleeper remote (an IKEA TRADFRI shortcut button in the Hotbox) is double-pressed, toggles the 'sleeper in hotbox' flag, so despite the name the same double press both sets and clears it.

Name: Turn on strobe light if someone enters through the kitchen door while alarm is engaged
Description: When the back outside (kitchen) door has been open for a second while the home alarm is armed away or armed night, turns on the kitchen strobe lamp plug, then waits with no time limit for the alarm to be disarmed before turning the strobe off. Single mode means further door openings are ignored while it waits.

Name: Turn on the front door light in relation to the sun position
Description: One minute after sunset, if the front door light is off or dimmer than brightness 50 (of 255), turns it on at 100% and 4628 K with a 20-second fade. It rechecks every 30 minutes while the sun is down and relights it only if it was switched off or dimmed; the loop ends the first time the light is found on and bright.

Name: Turn on UV vibes when Neon Uv Party starts
Description: When the Neon UV Party toggle turns on, closes all blinds (including the bedroom and hotbox ones), turns off the mains Adaptive Lighting switch, sets the hotbox lights (5-second fade), all inside lights and the patio lights to full-brightness blue, switches on all UV lamps and turns on the mimic-lights-on-screens toggle. Every step but the last ignores errors.

Name: Turn on volume control automations when Following speakers goes to on
Description: When music following turns on, enables the 'Speaker Automatic Volume v4' and 'Mute speakers when the room is empty' automations (automation.speaker_automatic_volume_v4 and automation.mute_speakers_when_the_room_is_empty), which manage speaker volume and mute speakers in empty rooms.

Name: Turn on Waiting Pakidge when Intelcom emails me and off when it arrives
Description: Runs on every email the IMAP integration reports and checks only the subject: 'ici une heure' (Intelcom's within-the-hour notice) turns on the Waiting Package toggle, while 'Votre colis est arriv' (package arrived) waits 10 minutes, since that email sometimes comes early, then turns the toggle off. Being single-mode, it ignores any email that arrives during that 10-minute wait.

Name: Turn parking horn on
Description: When a parking horn notification button is tapped (turn_parking_horn_on, or legacy blow_parking_horn), sounds the parking horn plug and parking exit camera siren until parking occupancy changes to clear for 7 seconds, or at most 5 minutes; a re-tap restarts that timer. If nobody is detected in the parking or back yard and the horn is off, Maxi must first confirm through a phone prompt within 2 minutes, or nothing sounds.

Name: Turn patio lights to dim colors when projector goes on
Description: When the patio projector light has been on for 3 seconds, or its RGB color or color temperature changes (held 1 second), sets the patio lights to the projector's current RGB color with a 2-second transition, turning them on if needed. If the neon UV party flag is on, it instead sets the patio lights, the server room lights and the projector itself to full-brightness blue.

Name: Turns on maintenance mode for all tablets During Live Concert
Description: Once live concert mode has stayed on for 5 minutes, turns on maintenance mode for all tablets (switch.maintenance_mode_all_tablets), then turns it off again when live concert mode has been off for 5 minutes, or after 5 hours at the latest.

Name: Undim budha lights when movie stops or people raise
Description: When the salon bed zone (radar zone 2) empties or the salon TV turns off, and the Buddha statue lights are on, nobody is sleeping in the salon and the neon UV party is off, fades the Buddha lights over 5 seconds to one third of the salon main lights' brightness. If the main lights are off, that brightness has no value and the step errors.

Name: unDim Wall lights when workshop TV is stopped
Description: When the workshop couch radar zone has been empty for 2 minutes or the workshop TV turns off, and the workshop wall light is on and neon UV party mode is off, sets the wall light to half the workshop light group's current brightness over 5 seconds, undoing the TV-time dimming.

Name: Undo Sleep actions when "sleeper in bedroom" is turned off
Description: Five seconds after the bedroom sleeper flag turns off, turns the bedroom tablet screen and motion detection back on, fades the bedroom chandelier to 100% at 5126 K over 45 seconds and turns the Bedroom AC thermostat back on so it resumes controlling the AC plug. If the bedroom speaker's title is the thunderstorm sound, it also stops that speaker and turns it off.

Name: Undo Sleep actions when "sleeper in patio" is turned off
Description: When the patio sleeper flag turns off and stays off for 5 seconds, turns the patio light group back on with a 45-second fade, without setting brightness or color.

Name: Undo Sleep actions when "sleeper in workshop" is turned off
Description: When the workshop sleeper flag turns off, fades the workshop lights that are currently off (except those labeled High Intensity Light) back on in warm white over 2 minutes, unmutes the workshop and hallway speakers, turns both workshop tablets' screens and motion detection back on, and unmutes the Workshop Table and Window voice assistants (the table unit's mute switch is named bedroom_assistant_mute).

Name: undo Sleeper action in salon when sleeper turns off
Description: When the salon sleeper flag turns off, fades the salon lights back on over 30 seconds and unmutes the Salon and Desktop voice assistants (both in the salon). It doesn't reopen the blinds or turn the assistant and desk tablet screens back on.

Name: Undo sleeper actions in hotbox
Description: Reverses hotbox sleeper mode: when the hotbox sleeper toggle turns off, opens the hotbox bed curtain, fades the hotbox lights (the whole Hotbox area plus the hotbox light group) up to 9% over 33 seconds, and turns the hotbox bed tablet screen back on.

Name: Undo sleeper actions when Sleeper in closet turns off
Description: When the closet sleeper flag turns off, switches the closet tablet's screen and motion detection back on and gently wakes the closet lights and closet string 2: magenta at 1%, then raised 2% at a time, 20 times two seconds apart (roughly +40% over about 40 seconds).

Name: Undo sleeping actions for Maxi when he awakes
Description: Once Maxi has been awake (sensor.is_maxi_asleep off) for 5 minutes, sends companion-app commands through Maxi's notification group to turn the phone's Do Not Disturb off and switch its screen back to automatic brightness, undoing the sleep settings.

Name: Unlock tablets on disarmed alarm
Description: Whenever the home alarm becomes disarmed, from any previous state, turns off Fully Kiosk maintenance mode on the hallway, workshop, kitchen (S6 Lite) and closet tablets, making their dashboards usable again after a triggered alarm locked them.

Name: Unmute Bathroom Muzak on Door Close
Description: When the bathroom door closes, unmutes the bathroom speaker (continuing even if the unmute fails) and sets its volume to 40%. It doesn't start any playback, so only music already playing there becomes audible again.

Name: Unmute patio assistant when people are present
Description: When the patio camera's person count rises above zero while patio motion is on, unmutes the patio voice assistant's microphone by turning its mute switch off. A second trigger fires when patio motion turns off, but it can never pass the motion-on condition, so in practice only a rising camera count unmutes it.

Name: Unmute playing bathroom speaker when someone enters
Description: Unmutes the bathroom speaker when bathroom motion starts, provided it is already playing and none of the kitchen speaker, workshop speaker or workshop Chromecast is playing. First sets a time-of-day volume: 30% from 08:45, 35% from 11:30, 30% from 21:30, 27% from 23:30, 24% from 01:00 and 20% from 03:00.

Name: Update cloudflare when IP changes
Description: Every time the UCG Ultra gateway's device tracker reports a different ip attribute, calls cloudflare.update_records so the Cloudflare integration refreshes its DNS records with the current public IP. There are no conditions.

Name: Update Universal Myriam's Tablet Entity area when it changes room
Description: Whenever the room sensor for Myriam's tablet changes (held 2 s), moves the universal Myriam tablet media player into the area whose ID is that sensor's state. This lets room-based automations, like the speaker muting when the tablet plays, follow the tablet.

Name: Vibe Arc - Enable/Disable Handler
Description: When the Vibe Arc master toggle is switched off, resets Vibe Arc's state: sets the Vibe Arc phase selector to Off, clears the paused and acting flags, and cancels the Vibe Arc override timer. Despite the name it only handles disabling, and it leaves the current lights and modes untouched.

Name: Vibe Arc - Override Detection
Description: When party mode, Kink Party or Acid Time changes while the Vibe Arc is enabled and not applying a phase itself (its acting flag is off), treats it as a manual override: turns on the arc's paused flag and (re)starts the 15-minute override timer, so the phase controller holds off until the timer runs out.

Name: Vibe Arc - Override Release
Description: When the 15-minute Vibe Arc override timer finishes and the arc is still enabled, turns off the arc's paused flag so the phase controller can choose phases again on its next trigger.

Name: Vibe Arc - Phase Controller
Description: While the Vibe Arc is enabled and not paused, picks its party phase on enable, at 01:00, 02:00 and 03:00, and 3 minutes after the head count changes or the patio gets loud (a new trigger restarts the run). First match wins: at most 2 people 01:00–06:00 → After Party; 3–4 people 02:00–06:00 → Wind Down; 9+, or 5+ with a noisy patio → Peak Party; 5–8 → Late Night 01:00–06:00, else Warming Up; otherwise Gathering if anyone is home.

Name: Vibe Arc - Phase Executor
Description: When the Vibe Arc phase changes while the arc is enabled and the phase isn't Off, runs the matching phase script: Gathering (cozy ambiance, UV and effects off), Warming Up (brighter lights, warm colors, flame effects), Peak Party (party mode and party ambiance), Late Night (Acid Time, psychedelic ambiance, trippy warm colors), Wind Down (modes off, cozy, dim warm light) or After Party (modes off, sexy ambiance).
Scripts Called: script.vibe_arc_gathering; script.vibe_arc_warming_up; script.vibe_arc_peak_party; script.vibe_arc_late_night; script.vibe_arc_wind_down; script.vibe_arc_after_party

Name: Vibrating color effect automation
Description: When the vibrating colors toggle changes, and only while both trippy effects are off: on turn-on, stops any running 'Set one light to vibrating colors' loops and restarts the effect via 'Change received lights to vibrating colors' on every lit light of the all-lights group that is in xy color mode; on turn-off, stops those loops and re-applies Adaptive Lighting to the same lights.

Name: Workshop Desk Hue Dial automation
Description: Controls the workshop light group from the Hue dial on the workshop table. Short presses: 1 toggles the lights, 2 sets 100% at 5238 K, 3 applies random fully saturated colors (switching on lights that were off) and 4 sets 1%; holding 1 toggles at 100% and 4922 K. Rotating down dims 15%; rotating up brightens 10%, or desaturates colored lights by 7 once at full brightness.

Name: Workshop Desk Hue Dial automation new
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the workshop table Hue dial to light.group_workshop_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off workshop UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: WorkShop LIFX paint room colours
Description: Maxi's 'LIFX - paint the room's colours' blueprint on the workshop light group (light.group_workshop_lights): when the group enters a colour mode, or its colour changes and the last-updated bulb isn't LIFX (preventing self-retriggers), waits 2 s (restarting on further changes), then paints up to 16 distinct colours from the group's lit colour bulbs across its LIFX members over 1 s. LIFX lights that are off get the palette but stay off.

Name: Workshop Tablet dial automation
Description: EPMatt's IKEA E1744 SYMFONISK blueprint for the workshop players, but bound to the hotbox tablet dial, the same device the Hotbox top dial automation uses. Turning left/right steps the volume down/up every 150 ms until the dial stops, on the workshop Chromecast (right turns use universal_workshop_chromecast) if unmuted and playing (or paused on non-Visuals content), else the workshop WiiM speaker (-0.09/+0.06). Presses drop the mute check: one plays/pauses, two skip track, three turn that player off.

Name: workshop tv hue dial automation
Description: Hue Dial Light Controller blueprint linking the workshop TV Hue dial to light.group_workshop_lights. Button 1 toggles (hold: 100%/4922 K toggle; five presses: LIFX morph), 2 sets 100% at 5238 K after switching off workshop UV switches and light effects (hold: pastel at 100%; five presses: toggle UV switch groups), 3 random colors (hold: warm saturated), 4 dims to 1% (hold: 1% warm saturated). Turning the dial steps brightness +10%/-15%, or at full brightness pales/deepens colors.

Name: All on defense script
Description: Intruder response (restart mode): rings Maxi's phone, sends Maxi and Myriam a Frigate snapshot, turns off music following, switches on both door horns and blasts a burglar alarm at full volume on eight speakers. With security occupancy on, the alarm stops once it clears for 2 minutes (max 30); otherwise it stops at once and triggers the volume-equalizer automation. Both paths re-enable music following and notify again; horns stay on.

Name: Apply random effect to all effect enabled lights
Description: Gives every effect-capable house light a new random effect at once (field: only_on, default on; turn it off to also switch on lights that are off). It picks the members of the all-lights group with more than one effect, starts Apply random existing effect to a light entity for each without waiting, and returns the count and list of changed lights; runs in parallel.

Name: Apply random existing effect to a light entity
Description: Puts a random effect on each given light (required field: light, one or more lights). Going through them one at a time, it turns each light on with a random entry from its own effect list, avoiding the current effect when another exists. Runs in parallel (up to 200 at once); Apply random effect to all effect enabled lights starts one run per light.

Name: Broadcast alert - display image on idle TVs
Description: Casts the required image URL to each Chromecast in non_playing_chromecasts and loads it with DashCast on hub_entity (the kitchen Google Hub by default). Then waits until lock_entity (the front door lock by default) is locked, up to timeout_minutes (3 by default), and turns those Chromecasts off; the hub is not turned off. An already-locked door ends the wait at once; parallel mode, max 5.

Name: Broadcast alert - display URL on idle TVs
Description: Loads the required url with DashCast (forced) on each Chromecast in non_playing_chromecasts and on hub_entity (the kitchen Google Hub by default). Then waits until lock_entity (the front door lock by default) is locked, up to timeout_minutes (3 by default), and turns those Chromecasts off; the hub is not turned off. An already-locked door ends the wait at once; parallel mode, max 5.

Name: Broadcast alert - flash hotbox lights (queued)
Description: Flashes the hotbox lights (light.group_hotbox_lights) in the required color field and then restores them by calling the shared flash-light-group script; optional duration_ms sets the hold time (2250 ms if omitted). It waits for each flash to finish and runs queue (max 10), so back-to-back requests flash one after another instead of overlapping.

Name: Broadcast alert - flash light group (internal impl)
Description: Shared flash helper with required fields light_group and color plus optional duration_ms. Snapshots each available member of the group (on/off state and RGB color), turns them all to the color, holds for duration_ms (2250 ms if omitted), then turns each back on with its saved RGB color or off if it was off. Runs queue (max 3), so overlapping flashes happen one after another.

Name: Broadcast alert - flash notification lights (queued)
Description: Flashes the house-wide notification lights (light.group_notifications_light) in the required color field and then restores them via the shared flash-light-group script. Optional duration_ms sets the hold; callers that omit it get 2250 ms, since the 1000 ms field default only pre-fills the UI. Runs queue (max 10) so overlapping alerts flash one after another; used by the important broadcast alert.

Name: Broadcast alert - pause playing chromecasts
Description: Pauses each Chromecast in the required playing_chromecasts list with one media_pause call per entity, ignoring errors; nothing resumes them afterwards. The important broadcast alert uses it to pause the Chromecasts that were playing when the alert began, except in party mode. Parallel mode, max 10.

Name: Broadcast alert - play audio URL
Description: Plays the required broadcast_url as a Music Assistant announcement at announce_volume (35 if omitted) on the home speaker group and the bedroom, closet and bathroom speakers at once. When include_hotbox is true (the important alert sets it when Lylou is alone) the hotbox speaker announces it too. There is no sleeper check, so the bedroom always hears it; parallel mode, max 10.

Name: Broadcast alert - send phone notification
Description: Sends a notification to the Maxi notification group, which currently reaches only Maxi's phone, passing the required phone_data object (title, message and extra data) straight through as the notify payload. Errors are ignored so a failed send does not break the calling alert. Used by the important broadcast alert; parallel mode, max 10.

Name: Broadcast alert - TTS announcement
Description: Speaks the required message field with the NabuDemon (OpenAI) voice on the home speaker group, the bathroom speaker and the bedroom speaker, skipping the bedroom while someone sleeps there. If NabuDemon is unavailable it falls back to Piper on the same speakers, where the bedroom still hears it when Maxi's sleep location is the bedroom. Parallel mode (max 10), so announcements can overlap.

Name: Change lights in an area to a random fake white
Description: Gives a room a so-called fake white (field: area, given as a list of areas). It takes the first room light group found there, skipping decorative and main groups, and sets each member light to its own random tint, hue 1-19 or 260-359 at 55% saturation, with a 1-second fade. Runs in parallel; the evenly spread hues it computes first go unused.

Name: Change received lights to blue
Description: Turns lights bright blue (RGB 0,0,255), the UV-lamp look. Inputs: area and/or light (a room's light groups or the listed lights; groups expanded, non-color lights skipped), only_on, brightness_pct (default 100%) and transition_speed (default 1 s); with neither area nor light, every light that is on changes. Starts Set one light to blue for each light without waiting and returns the lights used.

Name: Change received lights to random colors
Description: Gives lights random colors by starting 'Set one light to a random color' per light without waiting, so all change together, each at least 25 degrees from its current hue. Fields: area (uses the room's light groups if any), light (groups expanded), only_on, saturation (100%), transition_speed (1 s). Off lights are included unless only_on is set; with no area or light, only lit lights change; returns the changed lights.

Name: Change received lights to random pastel colors
Description: Gives lights random pastel colors using the fields area and/or light (groups expanded; rooms use their light groups when present), only_on, saturation (default 40%) and transition_speed (1 s); with neither target, every light that is on changes. Starts the per-light random pastel color script for each color-capable light at once, so each gets its own random hue, and returns the changed lights; runs in parallel.

Name: Change received lights to vibrating colors
Description: Starts the vibrating colors effect on lights chosen by area and/or light (groups expanded, non-color lights skipped) and only_on, or on every light that is on when neither is given. It starts Set one light to vibrating colors for each light without waiting and returns the lights used. It doesn't turn on input_boolean.vibrating_colors_effect, which the per-light loops need; the Vibrating color effect automation calls it once that is on.

Name: Change received lights to warm pale colors
Description: Gives lights warm pale colors (soft reds, pinks and purples) using the fields area and/or light (groups expanded; rooms use their light groups when present), only_on, saturation (default 40%) and transition_speed (1 s); with neither target, every light that is on changes. Starts the per-light warm pale color script for each color-capable light at once, so each gets its own hue, and returns the changed lights; runs in parallel.

Name: Change received lights to warm saturated colors
Description: Gives lights warm saturated colors (deep reds, magentas and purples) using the fields area and/or light (groups expanded; rooms use their light groups when present), only_on, saturation (default 100%) and transition_speed (1 s); with neither target, every light that is on changes. Starts the per-light warm saturated color script for each color-capable light at once, so each gets its own hue, and returns the changed lights; runs in parallel.

Name: Change received lights to white
Description: Turns lights white using the fields area and/or light (groups expanded; rooms use their light groups when present), only_on, color_temp_kelvin (default 4632 K), brightness_pct (100%), transition_speed (1 s) and turn_off_uv; with neither target, every light that is on changes. Starts Set one light to white (which stops effects first) for each capable light at once, turns off UV lamps in the same rooms, and returns the changed lights; runs in parallel.

Name: Changes selected light group to ordered fake white
Description: Makes a light group look 'fake white' by giving each member a different fully saturated hue, evenly spaced around the color wheel and applied instantly; each light keeps the same hue every run, only the update order is shuffled. Members that are off get turned on. The group must come from an undeclared selected_group variable; the area field is not used.

Name: Changes selected light group to random fake white
Description: Gives each light in a group a different fully saturated hue, evenly spaced around the color wheel but randomly assigned to the lights, so the mix reads as 'fake white' while the pattern changes every run. Applied instantly; members that are off get turned on. The group must come from an undeclared selected_group variable (no fields are declared).

Name: Chromecast Automatic Volume Adjustment script
Description: Sets one Chromecast's volume by time of day and unmutes it; the Chromecast comes in a received_chromecast variable (no declared fields). Levels are 35% from 03:00, 60% from 08:45, 90% from 11:30, 65% from 21:30, 55% from 23:30 and 45% from 01:00. If music following is on and the Chromecast's room is not among the active motion rooms, it mutes it again; runs in parallel, up to 10 at once.

Name: Daily calendar briefing - OpenDisplay
Description: Draws a briefing on the OD2734E0 OpenDisplay e-ink screen: a 3-day agenda built straight from six household calendars, the outside temperature, and one Journal de Montréal RSS story that rotates every run. The eink_briefing AI task summarizes it in three sentences, then refits it to the free space; failures fall back to the headline or first draft and post a notification. Preview renders without updating the screen; calls queue.

Name: Daily calendar briefing - OpenDisplay - Agenda only'
Description: Agenda-only version of the daily briefing for the OD2734E0 OpenDisplay e-ink screen: draws the next 7 days from the six household calendars without news or AI, white on black with yellow date headings, red times and the outside temperature, in up to 25 rows spaced to fill the screen ('More in full briefing' on overflow). Days without events are skipped. Preview renders without updating the screen.

Name: Equalize Home GRoup volume
Description: Sets the six WiiM speakers (hallway, kitchen, salon, lounge, workshop, hotbox) to the current average volume of the unmuted speakers, read from a template sensor, then mutes each one whose room is not in the active motion rooms sensor. Speakers in rooms with motion are not unmuted, just left as they are. No inputs; meant for an LLM to even out the house volume.

Name: Favorite currently playing song
Description: Favorites the song playing in Music Assistant. Unless the home speaker group is off, it presses that group's 'favorite current song' button; if the group is off, it presses the Music Assistant favorite button(s) whose entity ID contains Maxi's current room from the petro_v2 location sensor, meaning the speaker where Maxi is.

Name: Find myriam phone
Description: Copy of Find phone aimed at Myriam's S26: through the companion app it sets the phone's ring volume to level 100, turns Do Not Disturb off, then sends a high-priority notification titled Phone Lost (message Phone Found) on the alarm-stream channel so the phone can be found.

Name: Find phone
Description: Helps Maxi find their phone: turns the ring volume on Maxi's phone up to level 100, turns off Do Not Disturb, then sends a high-priority 'Phone Lost? / Phone Found!' notification on the alarm-stream channel, which plays at alarm volume. Exposed to the LLM for lost-phone requests.

Name: Generate and save LocalAI image
Description: Generates an image with LocalAI: sends the caller's prompt, model, size and steps variables (no fields are declared) to the local_ai_generate_image REST command, then uses the Downloader integration to save the first returned image URL as stable_diffusion.jpg, overwriting any previous file. Single mode, so requests during a generation are ignored.

Name: Generate back door camera description
Description: Describes what is happening at the back door, for the LLM. LLM Vision analyzes 2 seconds of the back door camera (up to 3 frames, with its memory enabled) and writes one sentence about any human activity; the result is saved to the LLM Vision timeline and returned as the script's response.

Name: Generate back yard camera description
Description: Describes what is happening in the back yard, for the LLM. LLM Vision analyzes 2 seconds of the back yard camera (up to 3 frames, with its memory enabled) and writes one sentence about any human activity; the result is saved to the LLM Vision timeline and returned as the script's response.

Name: Generate fake white colors
Description: Gives every lit, color-capable light that belongs to a light group (nested group entities skipped) a pale random tint at 30% saturation, choosing a red-orange hue (1-19) or a purple-to-pink hue (260-359) with equal odds, so colored bulbs blend into a 'fake white'. Takes no inputs.

Name: Generate front door camera description
Description: Describes what is happening at the front door, for the LLM. LLM Vision analyzes 2 seconds of the front door camera (up to 3 frames, with its memory enabled) and writes one sentence about any human activity; the result is saved to the LLM Vision timeline and returned as the script's response.

Name: Generate front street camera description
Description: Lets the LLM describe the street in front of the home: turns the front door PTZ camera to its street preset, waits 4 seconds, then has LLM Vision watch 5 seconds of the front door camera (up to 3 frames, with memory) and returns a one-sentence description of any human activity, also saved to the LLM Vision timeline. The camera is left on the street preset.

Name: Generate parking camera description
Description: Describes what is happening at the parking, for the LLM. LLM Vision analyzes 2 seconds from both the parking and parking exit cameras (up to 4 frames, with its memory enabled) and writes one sentence about any human activity; the result is saved to the LLM Vision timeline and returned as the script's response.

Name: Generate patio  camera description
Description: Describes what is happening on the patio, for the LLM. LLM Vision analyzes 2 seconds of the patio camera (up to 3 frames, memory off) and writes one sentence about the human activity there or its absence; the result is saved to the LLM Vision timeline and returned as the script's response.

Name: Generate security audit and text it to maxi
Description: On-demand security audit: LLM Vision describes the human activity (or its absence) in snapshots from the parking, parking exit, patio, back door, front door and back yard cameras, saving to its timeline; the Qwen 3.5 4B AI task boils that down to a brief overview, which is sent to Maxi's notification group as a high-priority red 'Security Report' on the security alerts channel.

Name: important broadcast alert in the house
Description: Whole-house alert; optional fields color, message, broadcast_url, phone_data, image and url. In parallel, via broadcast_alert scripts, it flashes notification lights in the color, speaks the message, plays the audio URL (hotbox too if Lylou is alone), notifies Maxi's phone, shows the url, else the image, on non-playing Chromecasts and pauses playing ones. Party mode skips speech, audio and pausing; runs queue (max 5), each ending with a 5 s pause.

Name: Inside only home defense script
Description: Indoor-only alarm, no horns or notifications: turns off music following, clears and turns off the home speaker group, then plays a burglar alarm at full volume on the home group plus the bathroom, bedroom and closet speakers. When security occupancy goes from detected to clear for 5 minutes it stops the alarm and re-enables music following; after 40 minutes without that, it ends doing neither. Restart mode.

Name: Jellyfin: Play Random Episode
Description: Plays a random episode of a TV show on a Jellyfin player (inputs: show_name and target_player, both required) by searching that player's media for the show name and playing one random result as an episode. The 'Jellyfin Search Failed' notification meant for an empty result never posts, because picking a random item from an empty list errors first.

Name: Join player to Music Assistant group
Description: LLM tool that adds an available Music Assistant speaker from the given area (required, or a specific player_to_add) to a playing sync group, optionally the one containing target_player. Without a target it joins the active group, the home group if several are active, or a lone playing speaker. It returns a status, stopping early if no speaker or leader is found or it is already grouped; calls queue.

Name: Launch Party Mode Jukebox on All Kiosks
Description: Opens the Music Assistant party jukebox page in Fully Kiosk on the kitchen tablet (Tablet Kitchen S6 Lite) and the workshop tablet at the same time, ignoring errors, for hosting gatherings. The hallway tablet step is disabled, so despite the name not every kiosk gets it.

Name: LLM Script for Music Assistant voice requests
Description: Assist/LLM tool built from the LLM Script for Music Assistant voice requests blueprint: takes media_type, media_id (semicolon-separated for several), artist, album and media_description, plus optional area, media_player and shuffle, and plays it via music_assistant.play_media on the named areas or players, else the whole-house speaker group (media_player.group_mass_home_group_speakers), leaving radio mode to the player's setting, then sets shuffle on/off. Runs in parallel; its description tells the LLM not to use it for YouTube.

Name: LLM Script to start TV SHOWS and MOVIES on TVs
Description: LLM tool that plays a Plex movie or show, shuffled, on a TV (inputs: media_id, is_description, media_type, library_name, media_player, area). If media_id is just a description, or the type or library is missing, an AI task with web search fills them in. It maps media_player or area to a universal Chromecast TV player and plays there, or stops listing valid TVs if none matches; overlapping calls are silently dropped.

Name: LLM Script to start TV SHOWS and MOVIES on TVs
Description: LLM tool (not for YouTube) to play a shuffled Plex movie or TV show on a TV; returns the target used. Fields: media_type (movie/tvshow), library_name (Movies/TV Shows), media_id (title), media_player and area. It reduces the player name to a room keyword and plays on matching Chromecast universal players; the area fallback (only without a player) matches just the area's first letter; overlapping calls are silently dropped.

Name: non-important broadcast alert in the house
Description: Low-priority alert using undeclared color, message, image and url variables. In parallel it sets lit notification lights to the color for 1.25 s then restores their RGB colors, speaks the message via the TTS helper unless party mode is on or all residents sleep, and shows the image (40 s) and/or url (until the front door unlocks, max 1 min) on non-playing Chromecasts, then turns them off. Queued, max 3.

Name: Patio Drinking Game Light Effect
Description: Patio drinking-game light effect, run by a voice-command automation. Snapshots the patio lights, sets the Zigbee patio light group to 1% red, turns one randomly picked light from the drinking-game group bright green, then restores the snapshot after 10 seconds.

Name: QuickBars - Display Camera PiP on all android TV
Description: QuickBars Display Camera PiP blueprint: broadcasts a quickbars.open event to every QuickBars Android TV, toggling a picture-in-picture view of the front door PTZ camera (fluent stream) in the top-left corner, titled 'Someone is at the door!', with a toast and 120 s auto-hide. The 'large' size is ignored because size mode stays auto, and the UDP/low-latency settings only apply to RTSP-URL sources, not camera entities.

Name: QuickBars - Show Front door Camera on TVs
Description: QuickBars Display Notification blueprint: shows every QuickBars TV a 'Someone is at the door' overlay with a front door camera snapshot for 120 s, replacing any current notification, and plays the ding-dong sound at 32% volume. Its 'Unlock the door' button unlocks the front door, sets the front door phone text to 'Come in, It's unlocked!', then back to 'Empty' once relocked or after a minute. Single mode ignores calls while it waits.

Name: Reset Tablet Endpoint interface
Description: Reloads a tablet's interface by restarting its Fully Kiosk browser, for the LLM (required field: area, a single area). It presses every Fully Kiosk 'restart browser' button whose entity id contains that area's id, so it only works for tablets whose entities are named after their room. Runs in parallel, silently dropping calls over the limit.

Name: Restart all network equipment
Description: Restarts the whole UniFi network at once by pressing the restart buttons of the four access points (hotbox, workshop, patio, salon), six switches (workshop TV mini, desktop lounge, server, salon, workshop, workshop library) and the UCG Ultra gateway. There is no staggering or confirmation, so everything reboots simultaneously.

Name: Script to launch Movie from Jellyfin on a TV
Description: Unfinished Jellyfin experiment. It has a request field for a movie title, but the first step overwrites it with a broken '[object Object]' value. It then browses the Jellyfin movie library through the salon Chromecast and tries to extract with a regex the media id of a title containing 'Step'; nothing is played or returned.

Name: Set one light to a random color
Description: Sets one light to a random hue at least 25° from its current one (any hue if it is off or not in a color mode). Inputs: target_light (required), saturation (default 100%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to random colors, in parallel (up to 200) so all lights change together.

Name: Set one light to a random pastel color
Description: Sets one light to a random pastel color: a random hue at least 25° from its current one (any hue if it is off or not in a color mode) at low saturation. Inputs: target_light (required), saturation (default 40%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to random pastel colors, in parallel (up to 200).

Name: Set one light to a warm pale color
Description: Sets one light to a warm pale color: a hue in 1–19° or 260–359° (soft reds, pinks, purples) at low saturation, preferring hues at least 25° from its current one. Inputs: target_light (required), saturation (default 40%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to warm pale colors, in parallel (up to 200).

Name: Set one light to a warm saturated color
Description: Sets one light to a warm saturated color: a hue in 1–19° or 260–359° (deep reds, magentas, purples) at full saturation, preferring hues at least 25° from its current one. Inputs: target_light (required), saturation (default 100%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to warm saturated colors, in parallel (up to 200).

Name: Set one light to blue
Description: Sets one light to bright blue (RGB 0,0,255). Inputs: target_light (required), brightness_pct (default 100%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to blue, in parallel (up to 200) so all lights change together.

Name: Set one light to vibrating colors
Description: Makes one light (target_light) shimmer around its current hue; started per light by Change received lights to vibrating colors. After a random start delay of up to twice the speed setting, it loops while input_boolean.vibrating_colors_effect and the light are both on, fading to hues 12–35° either side of the starting hue with randomized fade and hold times. Speed and saturation come from the vibrating color effect input_numbers.

Name: Set one light to white
Description: Sets one light (target_light, required) to white. If its effect list offers a stop option (effect_stop, stop_effect, Solid, or off while a colorloop runs), it applies that first, then sets color_temp_kelvin (default 4632 K), brightness_pct (default 100%) and transition_speed (default 1 s). Started once per light by Change received lights to white, in parallel (up to 200).

Name: Set whole house to a normal ambiance
Description: Resets the house to a normal ambiance (LLM tool). At once it sets all inside lights to 4282 K and 100% over 5 s, stops effects on lights that support effect_stop, replaces the upcoming queue with All favorited tracks if the home speakers are playing, turns off all UV lamps and reloads the tablet interfaces. The closing stop step returns an undefined target_data variable, so runs end aborted without a response.

Name: Set whole house to cozy ambiance
Description: Sets a cozy fireplace mood, all in parallel (no inputs; used by an LLM and the Vibe Arc Gathering and Wind Down phases): fireplace effect on the inside lights, flame on seven wall and ceiling lights, a warm 2668 K breathe on the patio lights and lounge lamp, Blaze on the lounge Nanoleaf via the non-standard light.set_effect, and Fireplace Visuals on Chromecasts that are off. The log shows both breathe steps rejected on 2026-10-07 because HA 2026.10 no longer accepts their kelvin option, so runs end in an error.

Name: Set whole house to kinky ambiance
Description: Kinky ambiance for the LLM when someone mentions a kink or play party or a BDSM event. At once it gives the inside lights that are on warm pale colors, starts the Local Kinky Time Visuals Plex playlist on idle TVs, plays the Local Kinky Time Music Playlist if the home speakers are off, closes all blinds, day or night, and turns on Kink Party.

Name: Set whole house to party ambiance
Description: Party setup, in parallel: closes all blinds, sets every color light (even off ones) to random pastel colors (30% saturation), runs LIFX morph on five lights and Pride 2015 on the salon door LEDs, starts the Colorful Backgrounds Visuals playlist on Chromecasts that are off, plays the New Local Party Playlist if the home speakers are off or idle and no live concert is on, and turns on party mode.

Name: Set whole house to psychedelic ambiance
Description: Psychedelic ambiance for the LLM when someone mentions mushrooms, acid or LSD. At once it gives every light that is on a random fully saturated color, runs the LIFX morph effect on five lights (turning them on), starts the 4k visuals Plex playlist on idle TVs, plays Psychedelic Music if the home speakers are off or idle, closes all blinds while the sun is up, and turns on Acid Time.

Name: Set whole house to sexy ambiance
Description: Sets a sexy fireplace mood step by step (no inputs): fireplace effect on the Philips bulbs, flame on the salon wall, workshop wall and lounge ceiling lights, a warm 2668 K breathe on the patio lights (50%) and lounge lamp, Fireplace Visuals on Chromecasts that are off, then Pornosonic on the home speakers. Its breathe steps use the kelvin option HA 2026.10 rejects (logged for the cozy ambiance script), so runs likely stop at the patio step and skip the rest.

Name: Speaker Automatic Volume Adjustment script
Description: Sets one speaker's volume by time of day and unmutes it: 30% from 08:45, 35% from 11:30, 30% from 21:30, 27% from 23:30, 24% from 01:00 and 20% from 03:00, then re-mutes it if music following is on and its room has no active motion. The speaker must be passed as received_speaker; the declared speaker_id field is overwritten, and it stops if none is given. Parallel, max 10.

Name: Start a random maxi playlist (Only use for playlists)
Description: Plays a Music Assistant playlist using the fields player_entity (first player leads; overrides area), requested_playlist (default Maxi's Smart Playlist; 'none' picks one of nine Maxi playlists at random) and area (that area's speakers). With no target it uses the Home Group, stopping and rejoining its room speakers first; specific players are unjoined, then grouped under the leader. Turns on shuffle, then plays; a new call restarts the run.

Name: Start plex media on requested player
Description: Despite its name, plays the Plex playlist named in a requested_playlist variable (no fields are declared), shuffled, on every Chromecast that is off, pausing 15 seconds after each start. An off-by-one index makes each pass check the next Chromecast in the list, so the first one is never used and the last pass reads past the end. Single mode, so calls during a run are ignored.

Name: Start requsted Playlist on plex for all unplaying chromecasts
