Description: Plays the Plex playlist named in the requested_playlist field, shuffled and muted, on every Chromecast and Google Hub that is off, skipping bedroom Chromecasts and devices in rooms listed by the active sleeper rooms sensor (hotbox top/down count as hotbox). Devices are handled one at a time, each given up to 1 minute to start playing. Single mode, so calls during a run are ignored.

Name: Start retro gaming session
Description: Starts the retro console on the salon TV; used when someone asks to play retro games and by the paired-controller automation. Powers the Sony TV on over RS-232 and, if the Android TV Remote entity isn't on yet, waits up to 30 seconds for it, then 3 more. Then selects HDMI 1, waits 3 seconds and selects it again, ignoring an error only on the first attempt.

Name: Stream a security camera on a Chromecast
Description: Shows live security camera feeds on a TV, for the LLM. Fields: camera (one or more Frigate cameras) and tv (a Cast media player). It converts the TV id into its Chromecast id ('tv' becomes 'chromecast', 'universal_' is dropped), turns that Chromecast off first if DashCast is already showing, then loads a go2rtc page with each camera's sub-stream through DashCast.

Name: This script can be used to show the cameras on all TVs
Description: Shows the live front door camera on every Chromecast: for each Cast media player whose id contains 'chromecast', except the hotbox one, it loads the front door camera's go2rtc sub-stream page through DashCast, forcing it over whatever is playing. Despite the name, no other camera is shown.

Name: Unjoin speaker or area from group
Description: LLM tool that takes Music Assistant speakers out of any group or sync group so they play on their own, using area (every Music Assistant speaker in that room) and/or player (one specific speaker), both optional. It unjoins everything found, or stops with a 'no Music Assistant speakers found' message when nothing matches. Calls run in parallel (up to 10), so several rooms can be split off at once.

Name: Vibe Arc - After Party Phase
Description: Runs when the Vibe Arc phase becomes After Party (at most 2 people home, 01:00–06:00). In parallel it turns off party mode, Acid Time, Kink Party and the trippy, vibrating and trippy-warm effects and runs Set whole house to sexy ambiance. That script currently aborts at its kelvin step, so this run errors too and leaves the Vibe Arc acting flag on instead of clearing it 3 seconds later.

Name: Vibe Arc - Gathering Phase
Description: Vibe Arc Gathering phase, normally chosen for 1-4 guests. It turns on the Vibe Arc acting flag (so override detection ignores the arc's own changes), then at once runs the cozy ambiance script, turns off all UV lamps and switches off the trippy, vibrating-colors and trippy-warm effect toggles. The flag clears 3 seconds after everything finishes.

Name: Vibe Arc - Late Night Phase
Description: Runs when the Vibe Arc phase becomes Late Night (5–8 people home between 01:00 and 06:00, patio not noisy). At the same time it turns on Acid Time and the trippy warm colors effect and runs Set whole house to psychedelic ambiance, keeping the Vibe Arc acting flag on until 3 seconds after so Override Detection ignores the Acid Time change.

Name: Vibe Arc - Peak Party Phase
Description: Runs when the Vibe Arc phase becomes Peak Party (9+ people home, or 5+ with a noisy patio). Turns on party mode and, at the same time, runs Set whole house to party ambiance, keeping the Vibe Arc acting flag on until 3 seconds after that script finishes so Override Detection doesn't treat the party-mode change as a manual override.

Name: Vibe Arc - Warming Up Phase
Description: Vibe Arc Warming Up phase, normally chosen for 5-8 guests. With the acting flag on, it fades the inside lights to about 78% over 90 s and the salon and lounge decorative lights to full over 30 s, turns on warm colors mode, turns off the trippy and vibrating effects, and gives four ceiling and wall lights (kitchen, salon, lounge, workshop) a full-brightness flame effect. Clears the flag 7 s later.

Name: Vibe Arc - Wind Down Phase
Description: Runs when the Vibe Arc phase becomes Wind Down (3–4 people home, 02:00–06:00). In parallel it turns off party mode, Acid Time, Kink Party and the trippy, vibrating and trippy-warm effects, runs Set whole house to cozy ambiance and fades the inside lights to 2200 K at 39% over 2 minutes. Current HA rejects that fade's kelvin option, so the run errors out without clearing the Vibe Arc acting flag.
